cancelled.location: Workbench → Status bar → Background tasks chip → Task list popover: status line under a task’s progress after the user stopped the export, dump or transfer with its Cancel button; short state word.

finished.location: Workbench → Status bar → Background tasks chip → Task list popover: status line under a task’s progress once the export, dump or transfer completed successfully; short state word.

running.location: Workbench → Status bar → Background tasks chip → Task list popover: status line under a task’s progress while the export, dump or transfer is still in progress; short state word.

tooltip.location: Workbench → Status bar → Background tasks chip: hover tooltip on the status-bar chip that toggles the list of exports, database dumps and data transfers running in the background.

connecting.location: Browser preview served by a relay or Embedded bridge → Loading overlay → Connection status: text shown while the hosted application connects to its configured server.

console_hint.value: Consultez la console du navigateur pour plus de détails.
console_hint.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Fatal initialization error: guidance beneath the error detail directing the user to browser-console diagnostics.

download_failed.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Initialization error: HTTP status included when the application WASM or bundled sample database cannot be downloaded.

downloading.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Download status: received megabytes shown when the server does not provide a content length.

downloading_progress.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Download status: received and total megabytes shown when the server provides a content length.

fact_cpu.value: Dans cette même seconde, votre CPU exécute plusieurs milliards d'instructions par cœur.
fact_cpu.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Rotating facts: CPU-instruction fact displayed while the application downloads.

fact_earth.value: Dans cette même seconde, la Terre vous transporte d'environ 30 km le long de son orbite.
fact_earth.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Rotating facts: Earth orbital-distance fact displayed while the application downloads.

fact_formula_one.value: Dans cette même seconde, une voiture de Formule 1 à pleine vitesse parcourt environ 100 mètres.
fact_formula_one.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Rotating facts: Formula 1 distance fact displayed while the application downloads.

fact_honeybee.value: Dans cette même seconde, une abeille bat des ailes environ 230 fois.
fact_honeybee.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Rotating facts: honeybee-wingbeat fact displayed while the application downloads.

fact_hummingbird.value: Dans cette même seconde, un colibri bat des ailes environ 50 fois.
fact_hummingbird.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Rotating facts: hummingbird-wingbeat fact displayed while the application downloads.

fact_light.value: Dans cette même seconde, la lumière parcourt la majeure partie du chemin jusqu'à la Lune.
fact_light.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Rotating facts: light-travel fact displayed while the application downloads.

fact_sound.value: Dans cette même seconde, le son parcourt environ 343 mètres dans la pièce.
fact_sound.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Rotating facts: sound-travel fact displayed while the application downloads.

fact_space_station.value: Dans cette même seconde, la Station spatiale internationale couvre presque 8 km.
fact_space_station.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Rotating facts: International Space Station distance fact displayed while the application downloads.

fact_ssd.value: Dans cette même seconde, votre SSD peut lire quelques gigaoctets.
fact_ssd.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Rotating facts: SSD read-speed fact displayed while the application downloads.

fact_tokenizer.value: Dans cette même seconde, le tokenizer de SQLLY traite des millions de lignes de SQL.
fact_tokenizer.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Rotating facts: SQLLY tokenizer-throughput fact displayed while the application downloads.

go_button.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Reveal button: button that dismisses the completed loading overlay and opens the workbench.

load_failed_title.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Fatal initialization error: heading shown when SQLLY cannot start.

loading_application.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Application module status: text shown while the JavaScript and WASM application modules load.

loading_chinook.value: Chargement de la base de données d'exemple Chinook…
loading_chinook.location: Standalone browser preview → Loading overlay → Sample status: text shown while the Chinook PostgreSQL sample finishes loading into PGlite.

preparing.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Initial status: text beneath the progress bar before the application WASM download begins.

preview_lead.value: Aperçu du navigateur SQLLY (démo dans l'onglet). Il ne peut pas atteindre vos serveurs. Installé sur votre machine, SQLLY est prêt en moins d'une seconde.
preview_lead.location: Standalone browser preview → Loading overlay → Introductory paragraph: demo limitations and installed-application startup comparison shown during download.

preview_ready_title.value: Aperçu du navigateur SQLLY (démo dans l'onglet) — prêt
preview_ready_title.location: Standalone browser preview → Document title: browser-tab title after the in-tab demo is ready.

preview_title.value: Aperçu du navigateur SQLLY (démo dans l'onglet)
preview_title.location: Standalone browser preview → Document title: browser-tab title while the in-tab demo loads.

ready.location: Browser preview → Loading overlay → Completion status: text shown when the application and sample data are ready to reveal.

served_lead.value: SQLLY se connecte aux bases de données configurées par votre administrateur. Les mots de passe restent sur le serveur.
served_lead.location: Browser preview served by a relay or Embedded bridge → Loading overlay → Introductory paragraph: connection and server-side password explanation shown during startup.

served_ready_title.location: Browser preview served by a relay or Embedded bridge → Document title: browser-tab title after the hosted application is ready.

served_title.location: Browser preview served by a relay or Embedded bridge → Document title: browser-tab title while the hosted application loads.

starting.location: Standalone browser preview → Loading overlay → Startup status: text shown while SQLLY initializes the in-tab application.

build_failed.value: Impossible de télécharger {filename} : le fichier n'a pas pu être construit ({error})
build_failed.location: Browser version → Results → Export to file → Download error: error written to the Messages pane when the browser could not build the in-memory file (blob) holding the exported data; short failure phrase.

file_refused.value: Impossible de télécharger {filename} : le navigateur a refusé le fichier ({error})
file_refused.location: Browser version → Results → Export to file → Download error: error written to the Messages pane when the browser refused to create a temporary download address for the exported file; short failure phrase.

link_failed.value: Impossible de télécharger {filename} : le lien de téléchargement n'a pas pu être créé ({error})
link_failed.location: Browser version → Results → Export to file → Download error: error written to the Messages pane when the browser could not create the hidden download link used to save the exported file; short failure phrase.

no_document.value: Impossible de télécharger {filename} : aucun document DOM n'est disponible
no_document.location: Browser version → Results → Export to file → Download error: error written to the Messages pane when an export file can’t be downloaded because the browser page document is unavailable; the export file name is available as {filename}.

no_window.value: Impossible de télécharger {filename} : aucune fenêtre DOM n'est disponible
no_window.location: Browser version → Results → Export to file → Download error: error written to the Messages pane when an export file (results.csv etc.) can’t be downloaded because the browser page window object is unavailable; the export file name is available as {filename}.

launch_failed.location: Opening a web link (help, sign-in and store pages) → Error message: error shown in the desktop app when the system command that opens the default web browser could not be started; {error} is the operating system’s error text.

no_dom_window.location: Opening a web link (help, sign-in and store pages) → Error message: reason inserted into the browser version’s new-tab failure message when the page’s window object is unavailable; short phrase.

not_web_url.value: seuls les liens http(s) peuvent être ouverts dans un navigateur
not_web_url.location: Opening a web link (help, sign-in and store pages) → Error message: error shown when a link SQLLY was asked to open is not an http or https web address, so it is refused for safety.

popup_blocked.value: le navigateur a bloqué le nouvel onglet (bloqueur de pop-up) — autorisez les pop-ups pour ce site
popup_blocked.location: Opening a web link (help, sign-in and store pages) → Error message: reason inserted into the browser version’s new-tab failure message when the browser’s popup blocker prevented the new tab from opening; short phrase.

tab_failed.value: impossible d'ouvrir un onglet de navigateur : {error}
tab_failed.location: Opening a web link (help, sign-in and store pages) → Error message: error shown in the browser version when a link could not be opened in a new browser tab; {error} is the specific reason (no page window, popup blocked, or open failed).

unsupported_os.value: le système d'exploitation actuel n'a pas de commande d'ouverture de navigateur configurée
unsupported_os.location: Opening a web link (help, sign-in and store pages) → Error message: error shown when the desktop app runs on an operating system it doesn’t know how to open the default web browser on.

window_open_failed.location: Opening a web link (help, sign-in and store pages) → Error message: reason inserted into the browser version’s new-tab failure message when the browser threw an error while opening the new tab; short phrase.

badge.location: Browser version → Dialogs that can’t do real work in a browser (connection editor, Entra accounts, security) → Preview banner: short colored badge at the left of the info strip across the top, marking the dialog as illustrative only.

unavailable_served.value: {feature} lorsque SQLLY s'exécute dans un navigateur
unavailable_served.location: Browser version served by a relay proxy or SQLLY Embedded bridge → Unavailable feature message: completes a sentence about a feature the browser page can’t offer, explaining why without pointing to the desktop app.

unavailable_standalone.value: {feature} dans l'aperçu du navigateur — utilisez l'application de bureau
unavailable_standalone.location: Browser preview (standalone, not served by a bridge) → Unavailable feature message: sentence shown when a desktop-only feature is used; {feature} names what is not available, and the text points the user to the desktop app.

edit.location: Command Palette (Cmd+Shift+P) → Command list: dim category label at the left of each row for editing commands such as Find, Replace, Minify or toggle Vim mode; matches the Edit menu name.

file.location: Command Palette (Cmd+Shift+P) → Command list: dim category label at the left of each row for file commands such as New Query, Open Notebook or Save Workspace; matches the File menu name.

help.location: Command Palette (Cmd+Shift+P) → Command list: dim category label at the left of each row for help commands such as SQLLY Help, Tip of the Day, Send Feedback or Check for Updates; matches the Help menu name.

query.location: Command Palette (Cmd+Shift+P) → Command list: dim category label at the left of each row for query commands such as Execute, Run notebook cell or Execute without rollback; matches the Query menu name.

quick_actions.location: Command Palette (Cmd+Shift+P) → Command list: dim category label at the left of rows for the user’s numbered quick-action SQL snippets (slots 1–9) defined in Settings.

tools.location: Command Palette (Cmd+Shift+P) → Command list: dim category label at the left of each row for tool commands such as Query Builder, Relationship Graph or Connection Health; matches the Tools menu name.

view.location: Command Palette (Cmd+Shift+P) → Command list: dim category label at the left of each row for layout commands such as toggling the sidebar, history or AI panel and splitting the editor; matches the View menu name.

window.location: Command Palette (Cmd+Shift+P) → Command list: dim category label at the left of each row for tab navigation commands such as next or previous editor tab; matches the Window menu name.

analyze_last_run.value: Analyser la dernière exécution avec l'IA
analyze_last_run.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that opens the AI panel seeded with the active tab’s most recent query run, including any error text and plan digest, and asks the AI to analyze it.

build_catalog.value: Créer le cache et les embedding de l'IA
build_catalog.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that precomputes the AI cache and vector embeddings for the active connection’s schema catalog; long-running, needs a connected server, and reports embedding counts when done.

invalidate_data.value: Effacer les données du catalogue IA
invalidate_data.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that wipes AI-derived catalog data (object summaries and embeddings) for the active connection while keeping the structural schema catalog; needs a connected server.

mcp_server_settings.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that opens the Settings window directly on the AI → MCP pane, where the built-in MCP (Model Context Protocol) server is configured.

toggle_agent_mode.location: Command Palette → View commands: command title that switches the AI panel’s agent mode on or off, letting the AI call database tools on the connected server; does nothing without an active connection.

add.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens the new-connection editor dialog for creating and saving a database connection profile.

connect.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title (verb, ending in an ellipsis because a window follows) that opens the Connection Management window to choose a saved connection and connect to it.

disconnect.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that disconnects the focused window’s active connection; a status-bar message appears if nothing is connected.

object_properties.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that opens the Properties dialog for the active connection’s server (the same pages as the server node’s context menu); requires a connected server.

open_in_terminal.value: Ouvrir la connexion dans le terminal
open_in_terminal.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that launches the active connection’s native command-line client (psql, mysql, sqlcmd, redis-cli, etc.) in a system terminal window.

refresh_explorer.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that reloads the Object Explorer sidebar tree, the active server’s schema nodes, and the IntelliSense catalog for that connection.

tunnel_profiles.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that opens the dialog for managing reusable tunnel profiles (proxy and/or SSH bastion hops) that connections can reference.

find.location: Command Palette → Edit commands: command title that opens the find bar in the active query editor tab (search only, without the replace field).

replace.location: Command Palette → Edit commands: command title that opens the editor’s find bar with the replace field shown, for find-and-replace in the active query tab.

format_document.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that reformats the entire SQL buffer of the active editor with the current formatting settings, ignoring any selection; distinct from “Format SQL”, which formats only a selection when there is one.

minify.location: Command Palette → Edit commands: command title that collapses SQL onto one compact line — the selection, or the statement under the caret — as a single undoable edit.

refresh_dates.value: Actualiser les dates en langage naturel
refresh_dates.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that re-evaluates every natural-language date marker (sqlly date comments such as “today”) in the active editor and rewrites the literal dates; the status bar reports how many changed.

toggle_vim_mode.location: Command Palette → Edit commands: command title that turns Vim-style modal keybindings in the query editor on or off and saves the choice to editor settings.

close_tab.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that closes the active editor tab (prompting to save when it has unsaved changes).

export_connections.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens a server and database picker and writes the chosen saved connections to a SQLLY connection file without any passwords.

export_credentials.value: Exporter la connexion avec les identifiants…
export_credentials.location: Command Palette → File commands: abbreviated command title (“Conn w/ Creds” = connections with credentials; keep it short) that exports chosen saved connections to a connection file including passwords in clear text.

import_connections.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that prompts for a SQLLY connection file and adds its connections to the saved list, moving any included passwords into the OS keychain.

import_connections_from_tools.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that prompts for a connection export from another database tool (for example TablePlus or Redis Insight) and imports the connections it recognizes.

export_for_pg_admin.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens a picker of saved PostgreSQL connections and saves them as a pgAdmin servers.json file without passwords; keep product and file names unchanged.

export_for_azure_data_studio.value: Exporter pour Azure Data Studio / VS Code (settings.json)…
export_for_azure_data_studio.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens a picker of saved connections and saves them as an Azure Data Studio / VS Code settings.json file without passwords; keep product and file names unchanged.

export_for_pg_service.value: Exporter en tant que fichier de service PostgreSQL (pg_service.conf)…
export_for_pg_service.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens a picker of saved PostgreSQL connections and saves them as a PostgreSQL connection service file (pg_service.conf) without passwords; keep the file name unchanged.

export_for_dbeaver.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens a picker of saved connections and saves them as a DBeaver data-sources.json file without passwords; keep product and file names unchanged.

export_for_data_grip.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens a picker of saved connections and saves them as a DataGrip / JetBrains dataSources.xml file without passwords; keep product and file names unchanged.

export_for_db_gate.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens a picker of saved connections and saves them as a DbGate connection environment (.env) file without passwords; keep product and file names unchanged.

manage_workspaces.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens the workspace manager to rename, duplicate, or delete saved workspaces (named sets of open tabs and layout).

new_notebook.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens a new, empty notebook tab mixing runnable SQL cells and Markdown cells.

new_query.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens a new, empty query editor tab.

new_window.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens an additional SQLLY workbench window.

open_folder.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that prompts for a folder and then opens the project-file picker listing every .sql file under it recursively.

open_notebook.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that prompts for a saved notebook file (.sqlnb) and opens it in a notebook tab.

open_project_file.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens SQLLY’s own project-file picker (folder and project SQL modes with file details and a SQL preview) instead of the system open dialog.

open_sql_file.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that prompts for a .sql file on disk and opens it in an editor tab.

open_sqlly_export.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that prompts for a .sqllyexport file (SQLLY’s portable saved result format) and opens it as read-only results without rerunning the query.

open_workspace.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that restores a previously saved workspace (its set of tabs and layout).

project_git.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title shown as “Project Folder: …” that opens the git window (status, diff, commit) for the folder opened with Open Folder.

reopen_closed_tab.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that reopens the most recently closed editor tab (also Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+T).

run_sql_file.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that opens the Run SQL File dialog to execute a script file against the active connection without loading it into the editor; refused while production writes are locked.

save_notebook.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that saves the active notebook tab to a .sqlnb file; when the active tab is not a notebook, the status bar says one is required.

save_results.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that saves the active result set to a file, the format chosen by the extension picked in the save dialog (CSV, JSON, Excel, Markdown, SQL, …).

save_sql.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that saves the active editor tab’s SQL text to a .sql file on disk.

save_to_library.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that saves the active tab’s SQL into the SQL Library folder so it appears in the library sidebar.

save_workspace_as.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that saves the current set of open tabs and layout as a new named workspace.

app_store_edition.location: Command Palette → Help commands: command title (Mac App Store edition only) that opens a window listing what the sandboxed App Store edition cannot do and what to use instead.

check_for_updates.location: Command Palette → Help commands: command title (hidden in the App Store edition) that checks for a newer SQLLY release and opens the update dialog or reports “up to date” in the status bar.

formatting_directives.location: Command Palette → Help commands: command title that opens the reference window documenting the “-- sqlly …” directive comments that control how results are formatted and displayed.

send_feedback.location: Command Palette → Help commands: command title that screenshots the current window and opens the Send Feedback dialog for annotating it and describing a problem or suggestion.

sqlly_help.location: Command Palette → Help commands: command title that opens the SQLLY Help window, generated from the live command list and keyboard shortcut maps.

tip_of_the_day.location: Command Palette → Help commands: command title that opens the Tip of the Day dialog at the tip the next startup would show.

unlock_sqlly.location: Command Palette → Help commands: command title (Mac App Store edition only) that opens the purchase window for the lifetime unlock, with Buy and Restore Purchases.

open.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that prompts for a saved execution plan file (for example .sqlplan) and opens it in the query plan viewer.

paste.value: Coller le plan depuis le presse-papiers
paste.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that reads execution plan text copied elsewhere from the clipboard and opens it in the query plan viewer; the status bar reports an empty clipboard.

profile.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that runs the active query with profiling to capture an actual plan with runtime statistics; the parenthetical warns it is refused for anything other than a SELECT.

ask_schema.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that opens the AI panel on its Ask Schema section, for asking the AI questions about the connected database’s tables and relationships.

cancel.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that cancels the query currently running in the active tab.

execute.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that runs the SQL in the active editor tab (the selection, or the whole script) against the active connection.

execute_keep_results.value: Exécuter dans un Nouvel Onglet de Résultat
execute_keep_results.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that runs the active query but keeps the previous results, adding the new output as an additional result tab instead of replacing it.

execute_no_rollback.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that runs the query once with the connection’s safety rollback wrap disabled, so DDL or changes actually persist; applies to that single run only.

explain_error.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that opens the AI panel with a plain-language “explain this error” request for the most recent failed query.

explain_estimated.value: Expliquer la Requête (Plan Estimé, Sans Exécution)
explain_estimated.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that captures the optimizer’s estimated execution plan without running the statement; the parenthetical stresses that nothing executes.

explain_plan.value: Expliquer la Requête (Réel, Exécute la Requête)
explain_plan.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that runs the statement to capture its actual execution plan (also Cmd+L); the parenthetical warns that the query really executes.

explain_plan_ai.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that opens the AI panel with a digest of the active tab’s captured execution plan (findings and expensive operators) and asks for an explanation.

format_sql.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that reformats the selected SQL, or the whole buffer when nothing is selected, using the current SQL formatting settings.

generate_sql.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that opens the AI panel on its Generate SQL section, where a plain-language request is turned into a SQL query.

history.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that opens the query history browser to search, pin, and re-run previously executed queries.

run_all_notebook_cells.value: Exécuter Toutes les Cellules du Carnet
run_all_notebook_cells.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that runs every SQL cell of the active notebook tab in order.

run_notebook_cell.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that runs the currently focused SQL cell in the active notebook tab.

run_on_targets.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that opens the “Run on…” dialog to pick several saved connections and run the current statement against each of them.

run_picker.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that opens a checklist of the statements in the active editor so a chosen subset can be run as one batch.

send_selection_to_ai.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that sends the selected SQL in the editor to the AI panel as context for a question or rewrite.

validate.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that checks the active tab’s SQL against the connected server without running it and shows any problems as editor diagnostics.

slot1.location: Command Palette → Quick Actions: title of the built-in Describe table quick action assigned to slot 1.

auto_refresh10s.value: Résultats : Actualisation automatique toutes les 10 s
auto_refresh10s.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title (one of a set of auto-refresh intervals; “10s” means 10 seconds) that reruns the active tab’s query automatically every 10 seconds.

auto_refresh30s.value: Résultats : Actualisation automatique toutes les 30 s
auto_refresh30s.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title (one of a set of auto-refresh intervals; “30s” means 30 seconds) that reruns the active tab’s query automatically every 30 seconds.

auto_refresh5s.value: Résultats : Actualisation automatique toutes les 5 s
auto_refresh5s.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title (one of a set of auto-refresh intervals; “5s” means 5 seconds, the shortest option) that reruns the active tab’s query automatically every 5 seconds.

auto_refresh60s.value: Résultats : Actualisation automatique toutes les 60 s
auto_refresh60s.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title (one of a set of auto-refresh intervals; “60s” means 60 seconds, the longest option) that reruns the active tab’s query automatically every minute.

auto_refresh_off.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that stops automatic re-running of the active tab’s query, turning off any auto-refresh interval set by the sibling commands.

copy_staged_sql.value: Résultats : Copier les modifications préparées en SQL
copy_staged_sql.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that copies the SQL script for the result grid’s pending (staged, unsaved) cell edits, inserts, and deletes to the clipboard.

discard_staged.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that throws away all pending (staged, unsaved) edits in the active result grid without writing them to the database.

filter_rows.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that opens the filter builder for the active result grid to show only rows matching conditions.

find_in_grid.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that opens (or closes) the find bar over the active result grid to search and highlight cell values.

focus_toggle.value: Résultats : Basculer le focus entre l’éditeur et la grille
focus_toggle.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that moves keyboard focus back and forth between the query editor and the result grid.

goto_column.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that opens a column picker for the active result grid and scrolls to the chosen column.

preview_staged_sql.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that shows the SQL that would be run to save the result grid’s pending (staged) edits, for review before saving.

refresh.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that reruns the active tab’s query to refresh its result grid.

save_staged.value: Résultats : Enregistrer les modifications mises en attente
save_staged.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that writes the result grid’s pending (staged) cell edits, new rows, and deletions to the database.

sort_ascending.value: Résultats : Trier la colonne active par ordre croissant
sort_ascending.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that sorts the active result grid by the column holding the cell cursor, smallest to largest (keyboard-friendly sort).

sort_descending.value: Résultats : Trier la colonne active par ordre décroissant
sort_descending.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that sorts the active result grid by the column holding the cell cursor, largest to smallest (keyboard-friendly sort).

stage_delete_row.value: Résultats : Marquer la ligne pour suppression
stage_delete_row.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that marks the selected result-grid row as a pending deletion, applied only when staged changes are saved.

stage_insert_row.value: Résultats : Mettre en attente une nouvelle ligne
stage_insert_row.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that adds a new pending row to the active result grid for data entry, inserted only when staged changes are saved.

stage_redo.value: Résultats : Refaire la modification mise en attente
stage_redo.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that re-applies the last undone pending (staged) edit in the result grid.

stage_undo.value: Résultats : Annuler la modification mise en attente
stage_undo.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that reverts the most recent pending (staged) edit in the result grid, before anything is saved to the database.

transpose.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that toggles a transposed view of the active result set, turning columns into rows and rows into columns.

lock_read_only.value: Verrouiller la connexion en lecture seule maintenant
lock_read_only.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that immediately ends any temporary unlock on a read-only (SELECT-only) connection, blocking writes again.

lock_writes.value: Verrouiller les écritures en production maintenant
lock_writes.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that immediately ends any temporary production-write unlock, so writes on production-marked connections are blocked again.

unlock_read_only15m.value: Déverrouiller la connexion en lecture seule pendant 15 minutes
unlock_read_only15m.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that temporarily allows non-SELECT statements on a connection set to read-only, for 15 minutes (longest of three durations).

unlock_read_only1m.value: Déverrouiller la connexion en lecture seule pendant 1 minute
unlock_read_only1m.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that temporarily allows non-SELECT statements on a connection set to read-only, for 1 minute (singular; shortest of three durations).

unlock_read_only5m.value: Déverrouiller la connexion en lecture seule pendant 5 minutes
unlock_read_only5m.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that temporarily allows non-SELECT statements on a connection set to read-only, for 5 minutes (middle of three durations).

unlock_writes15m.value: Déverrouiller les écritures en production pendant 15 minutes
unlock_writes15m.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that temporarily allows data-changing statements on a connection marked as production, for 15 minutes (longest of three durations).

unlock_writes1m.value: Déverrouiller les écritures en production pendant 1 minute
unlock_writes1m.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that temporarily allows data-changing statements on a connection marked as production, for 1 minute (singular; shortest of three durations).

unlock_writes5m.value: Déverrouiller les écritures en production pendant 5 minutes
unlock_writes5m.location: Command Palette → Query commands: command title that temporarily allows data-changing statements on a connection marked as production, for 5 minutes (middle of three durations).

refresh.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that reloads the IntelliSense (autocomplete) catalog of tables, columns, and routines for the active connection; requires a connection.

move_to_new_window.value: Déplacer l'onglet vers une nouvelle fenêtre
move_to_new_window.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that moves the active editor tab out into a brand-new workbench window (the browser build reports it has only one window).

rename.location: Command Palette → File commands: command title that starts inline renaming of the active editor tab’s title.

activity_monitor.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that opens the Activity Monitor pane showing the server’s live sessions, blocking chains, expensive queries, and wait statistics.

add_firewall_rule.value: Ajouter mon IP au pare-feu du serveur…
add_firewall_rule.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that adds this computer’s public IP address to the Azure SQL server firewall for the active connection (needs an Azure Entra sign-in).

azure_sql_connection.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that opens the Azure (Microsoft Entra) account dialog to sign in and discover Azure SQL servers for new connections.

backup_restore.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that opens the Backup / Restore dialog for backing up or restoring a database on the active connection.

chart_dashboard.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title (noun) that opens the Chart Dashboard, showing every saved chart as a live tile that reruns its query.

command_palette.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title naming the Command Palette itself (the searchable list of all commands, Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+P); choosing it reopens the palette.

connection_health.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title (noun) that opens the Connection Health dashboard listing saved connections with live status, latency, and diagnostics.

connection_management.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that opens the Connection Management window for browsing, editing, organizing, and connecting saved connections.

data_compare.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that opens Data Compare, comparing table rows across two connections and scripting a reviewable sync.

data_transfer.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that opens the Data Transfer wizard to copy tables and their data from one connection to another.

deploy_cart.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that opens the Deploy Cart window, where objects gathered from any connection are deployed as one dependency-ordered script.

designers.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that opens the Designers dialog with guided Table, Index, and Foreign Key builders that script reviewed DDL into a new editor tab.

disk_usage.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that opens the Disk Usage pane showing per-database sizes for the connected server (and file layout on SQL Server).

export_database_sql.value: Exporter la Base de Données en SQL…
export_database_sql.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that opens the dump dialog to export a database’s schema and/or data as a SQL script file.

export_schema_docs.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that writes the loaded schema as a Markdown data dictionary to a file the user picks.

extended_events.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that opens the SQL Server Extended Events pane listing event sessions, their state, and details, with scripted start and stop.

external_editor.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that opens the active tab’s SQL in the user’s preferred external text editor (VS Code, Zed, Sublime, etc.).

import_export.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that opens the Import / Export wizard for loading CSV, JSON, Excel, or .sqllyexport files into tables, or exporting data.

import_from_clipboard.location: Command Palette → Tools commands: command title that opens the import wizard using tabular text on the clipboard as the source, typically to create a new table from it.

index_analyzer.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name that opens the Index Analyzer pane for the active connection, listing index usage (seeks, scans, unused indexes) to find drop candidates; trailing ellipsis means a pane opens.

keybindings.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name that opens Settings at the Keyboard Shortcuts page where the user views and rebinds shortcuts; “Keyboard Shortcuts” is the page name, ellipsis means a window opens.

object_browser.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name that opens the Object Browser pane, an inventory of the current database’s tables and other objects with sizes and row counts.

preferences.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name that opens the Settings (Preferences) window; standard app-preferences wording, ellipsis means a window opens.

query_builder.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name that opens the visual Query Builder for the active connection, where tables and joins are picked graphically to compose a SELECT; needs a connection.

query_store.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name that opens the Query Insights pane showing top and slow queries from the server’s statistics (SQL Server Query Store, pg_stat_statements, Performance Schema).

quick_open.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name (also Cmd/Ctrl+P) that switches the palette to object search, to jump to a table, view, procedure, database or connection by name.

redis_cluster_topology.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name for Redis connections that opens the Cluster Topology pane showing cluster nodes, master/replica roles, hash-slot ranges and a per-node connection trace.

redis_key_view.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name for Redis connections that opens the Key View pane, first prompting for a key name, then showing and editing that key’s value and TTL.

redis_memory_analyzer.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name for Redis connections that opens the Memory Analyzer report pane, breaking down memory use by key type, TTL and largest keys.

redis_profiler.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name for Redis connections that opens the Activity Monitor on its live Profiler tab, which streams the commands the server is executing.

redis_pub_sub.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name for Redis connections that opens the Activity Monitor on its live Pub/Sub tab to subscribe to channels and watch published messages; “Pub/Sub” is the Redis term.

relationship_graph.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name that opens the Relationship Graph (ER diagram) of the active connection’s tables and foreign keys; needs a connection, no ellipsis.

result_snapshots.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name that opens the Result Snapshots browser listing previously saved copies of query result grids; noun phrase, not available in the browser preview.

save_schema_snapshot.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name that opens the dialog to capture and save a snapshot of the current database’s schema for later drift comparison in Schema History; requires a selected database.

saved_charts.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name that opens the Saved Charts panel, the library of charts the user saved from result grids; noun phrase, not available in the browser preview.

schedule_task.value: Planifier une tâche (Dump, Sauvegarde ou Exportation de requête)…
schedule_task.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name that opens the scheduling dialog to set up a recurring automated task: a database dump, a backup, or exporting a query’s results; desktop only.

schema_compare.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name that opens the Schema Compare tool, which diffs the schemas of two databases and can generate a migration script.

schema_history.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name that opens the Schema History timeline of saved schema snapshots for the current database, to review and compare drift over time; requires a selected database.

search_database_value.value: Rechercher une valeur dans la base de données…
search_database_value.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name that opens the database-wide search dialog, which looks for a given value in every table and column of the active connection.

security.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name that opens the Security tool for the active server: logins, users and roles (or the ACL user list and log for Redis); noun used as a tool title.

server_dashboard.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name that opens a live Server Dashboard pane for the active connection with health metrics such as connections and transactions per second; one per server.

sql_agent.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name that opens the SQL Agent pane for SQL Server, listing scheduled Agent jobs and their schedules and history; “SQL Agent” is the product feature name.

structure_editor.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name that opens the structure editor for the table selected in the Object Explorer, to add, change or drop columns; shows a hint if no table is selected.

template_explorer.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name that opens the Template Explorer dialog, a browsable library of ready-made SQL script templates and snippets to insert into the editor.

tenant_scoping.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name that opens the Tenant Scoping settings dialog for the active connection’s current database, a multi-tenant safety feature limiting queries to one tenant.

test_data_generator.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Tools category: command name that opens the Test Data Generator pane, which creates and inserts realistic fake sample rows into tables of the active connection.

commit.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Query category: command name (shortcut Cmd/Ctrl+Option/Alt+Enter) that commits the open manual transaction of the active query tab; “Transaction:” is a group prefix.

rollback.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Query category: command name (shortcut Cmd/Ctrl+Option/Alt+Backspace) that rolls back the open manual transaction of the active query tab, discarding its changes.

toggle_mode.value: Transaction : Basculer en mode de validation manuelle
toggle_mode.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Query category: command name that switches the active query tab between auto-commit and manual commit mode, where changes stay uncommitted until Commit or Rollback.

close_split.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name that closes the split editor layout and returns to a single editor pane.

detach_results.value: Détacher les résultats dans une fenêtre
detach_results.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name (Cmd/Ctrl+Option/Alt+J) that moves the active tab’s results pane out into its own separate window; desktop only.

reattach_results.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name that brings a detached results window back into the main window below the editor; counterpart of “Detach Results to Window”.

search_schema.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name that shows the AI side panel opened on its schema Search section, for finding tables and columns by name or meaning.

split_horizontal.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name that splits the editor area into two panes stacked one above the other, each showing its own tab.

split_same_buffer_horizontal.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name that splits the editor top and bottom with both panes showing the same open script, so two parts of one file are visible at once.

split_same_buffer_vertical.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name that splits the editor left and right with both panes showing the same open script, so two parts of one file are visible at once.

split_vertical.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name that splits the editor area into two side-by-side panes (left and right), each showing its own tab.

sql_library.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name that shows the sidebar switched to the SQL Library, the user’s collection of saved queries and snippets; imperative “Show”.

theme_dark.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name that switches the app color theme to Dark; “Theme:” is a group prefix shared by the four theme commands.

theme_high_contrast.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name that switches the app color theme to the High Contrast accessibility theme; “Theme:” is a shared group prefix.

theme_light.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name that switches the app color theme to Light; “Theme:” is a group prefix shared by the four theme commands.

theme_system.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name that makes the app follow the operating system’s light/dark appearance automatically; “Theme:” is a shared group prefix.

toggle_ai_panel.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+I) that shows or hides the AI assistant side panel; “Toggle” means show if hidden, hide if shown.

toggle_ai_visibility.value: Basculer la visibilité du panneau IA
toggle_ai_visibility.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: alternate command name, found by searching “show” or “hide”, that does the same as Toggle AI Panel: shows or hides the AI side panel; must differ from that title.

toggle_cell_details.value: Basculer le panneau des détails de la cellule
toggle_cell_details.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name that shows or hides the Cell Details panel beside the results grid, which displays the full value of the selected cell and its row.

toggle_history_panel.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name (Cmd/Ctrl+Option/Alt+H) that shows or hides the version history panel of the active query tab, a timeline of earlier script versions to restore.

toggle_intellisense_debug.value: Basculer le panneau de débogage IntelliSense
toggle_intellisense_debug.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name for a diagnostic tool that shows or hides the IntelliSense debug panel with the completion/language-server state; “IntelliSense” stays as is.

toggle_log_console.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+L) that shows or hides the Log Console, the panel of diagnostic log messages from the app.

toggle_results_maximized.value: Basculer les résultats en plein écran
toggle_results_maximized.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+J) that maximizes the results pane over the editor, or restores the normal split if it is already maximized.

toggle_results_pane.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name (Cmd/Ctrl+J) that shows or hides the results pane below the query editor.

toggle_sidebar.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name (Cmd/Ctrl+B) that shows or hides the left sidebar holding the Object Explorer and SQL Library.

zoom_in.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name that enlarges the query editor’s text size one zoom step; standard “Zoom In” wording.

zoom_out.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name that shrinks the query editor’s text size one zoom step; standard “Zoom Out” wording.

zoom_reset.location: Command Palette → Commands list → View category: command name that resets the query editor zoom to 100 percent; use the platform’s standard “Actual Size” menu wording.

next_editor_tab.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Window category: command name (Ctrl+Tab) that activates the next query editor tab to the right in the tab strip.

next_tab_in_history.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Window category: command name (Ctrl+Option/Alt+Right) that goes forward in the history of recently visited tabs, like a browser’s Forward button.

previous_editor_tab.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Window category: command name (Ctrl+Shift+Tab) that activates the previous query editor tab to the left in the tab strip.

previous_tab_in_history.location: Command Palette → Commands list → Window category: command name (Ctrl+Option/Alt+Left) that goes back to the previously visited tab in tab history, like a browser’s Back button.

no_matches.location: Command Palette → Commands mode: empty-state message in the result list when no command matches the text typed in the search box.

search_placeholder.location: Command Palette → Commands mode: placeholder in the search input at the top of the palette (opened with Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+P), inviting the user to type a command name.

index_empty.value: Connectez-vous et développez un serveur pour indexer ses objets
index_empty.location: Command Palette → Go to Object mode: empty-state message when no database objects are indexed yet, telling the user to connect and expand a server in the Object Explorer first.

keyboard_hint.location: Command Palette → Go to Object mode: hint line under the result list; {primary_modifier} is Cmd or Ctrl and {option_modifier} is Option or Alt; click with them opens the object or a preview.

kind_database.location: Command Palette → Go to Object mode → Result row: short kind label in the left column marking the match as a database; keep very short.

kind_function.location: Command Palette → Go to Object mode → Result row: abbreviated kind label (short for function) in the narrow left column marking the match as a SQL function.

kind_procedure.location: Command Palette → Go to Object mode → Result row: abbreviated kind label (short for stored procedure) in the narrow left column marking the match as a procedure.

kind_server.location: Command Palette → Go to Object mode → Result row: short kind label in the left column marking the match as a server connection.

kind_table.location: Command Palette → Go to Object mode → Result row: short kind label in the left column marking the match as a table.

kind_view.location: Command Palette → Go to Object mode → Result row: short kind label in the left column marking the match as a database view (noun, not the verb).

no_matches.location: Command Palette → Go to Object mode: empty-state message in the result list when objects are indexed but none matches the typed name.

search_placeholder.value: Aller à la table, vue, procédure, base de données ou connexion…
search_placeholder.location: Command Palette → Go to Object mode: placeholder in the search input (opened with Cmd/Ctrl+P) listing the kinds of objects the user can jump to by typing a name.

remove.location: Stock components → Attachment: button that removes the selected attachment from the current draft.

retry.location: Stock components → Attachment: button that retries an attachment operation after a failure.

april.location: Stock components → Calendar → Month selector: month name for April.

august.location: Stock components → Calendar → Month selector: month name for August.

december.location: Stock components → Calendar → Month selector: month name for December.

february.location: Stock components → Calendar → Month selector: month name for February.

january.location: Stock components → Calendar → Month selector: month name for January.

july.location: Stock components → Calendar → Month selector: month name for July.

june.location: Stock components → Calendar → Month selector: month name for June.

march.location: Stock components → Calendar → Month selector: month name for March.

may.location: Stock components → Calendar → Month selector: month name for May.

november.location: Stock components → Calendar → Month selector: month name for November.

october.location: Stock components → Calendar → Month selector: month name for October.

september.location: Stock components → Calendar → Month selector: month name for September.

friday.location: Stock components → Calendar → Week header: abbreviated column label for Friday.

monday.location: Stock components → Calendar → Week header: abbreviated column label for Monday.

saturday.location: Stock components → Calendar → Week header: abbreviated column label for Saturday.

sunday.location: Stock components → Calendar → Week header: abbreviated column label for Sunday.

thursday.location: Stock components → Calendar → Week header: abbreviated column label for Thursday.

tuesday.location: Stock components → Calendar → Week header: abbreviated column label for Tuesday.

wednesday.location: Stock components → Calendar → Week header: abbreviated column label for Wednesday.

go_to_slide.location: Stock components → Carousel → Pagination: accessible label for the button that opens the slide numbered by the current placeholder.

label.location: Stock components → Carousel: accessible label identifying the complete slide carousel region.

next.location: Stock components → Carousel → Navigation: accessible label for the button that shows the next slide.

pagination.location: Stock components → Carousel → Pagination: accessible label for the group of slide selector buttons.

previous.location: Stock components → Carousel → Navigation: accessible label for the button that shows the previous slide.

slide.location: Stock components → Carousel → Slide status: accessible announcement giving the current slide number and total slide count.

close.location: Stock components → Financial chart → Value labels: label for the closing price.

high.location: Stock components → Financial chart → Value labels: label for the highest price.

low.location: Stock components → Financial chart → Value labels: label for the lowest price.

open.location: Stock components → Financial chart → Value labels: label for the opening price.

alpha.location: Stock components → Color picker → HSLA controls: label for the opacity alpha slider.

hsla.location: Stock components → Color picker: tab label for editing hue, saturation, lightness, and alpha values.

hue.location: Stock components → Color picker → HSLA controls: label for the hue slider.

lightness.location: Stock components → Color picker → HSLA controls: label for the lightness slider.

palette.location: Stock components → Color picker: tab label for choosing a color from the palette.

saturation.location: Stock components → Color picker → HSLA controls: label for the saturation slider.

empty.location: Stock components → Combo box → Results: empty state shown when the search matches no items.

placeholder.location: Stock components → Combo box: placeholder shown when no item has been selected.

search_placeholder.location: Stock components → Combo box → Search field: placeholder for filtering the available items.

empty.location: Stock components → Command palette → Results: empty state shown when no commands match the query.

placeholder.location: Stock components → Command palette → Search field: placeholder inviting a command name or search query.
Stock components → Date picker: placeholder shown when no date has been selected.

time.location: Stock components → Date picker → Time section: label for the selected time controls.

cancel.location: Stock components → Dialog → Actions: button that dismisses the dialog without accepting its changes.

ok.location: Stock components → Dialog → Actions: button that accepts the dialog and closes it.

accept_both.location: Stock components → Diff → Merge conflict actions: button that resolves a conflict by retaining both changes.

accept_current.location: Stock components → Diff → Merge conflict actions: button that resolves a conflict using the current change.

accept_incoming.location: Stock components → Diff → Merge conflict actions: button that resolves a conflict using the incoming change.

accepted_both.location: Stock components → Diff → Merge conflict status: message shown after retaining both changes.

accepted_current.location: Stock components → Diff → Merge conflict status: message shown after accepting the current change.

accepted_incoming.location: Stock components → Diff → Merge conflict status: message shown after accepting the incoming change.

add_annotation.value: Ajouter une annotation à la ligne %{line}
add_annotation.location: Stock components → Diff → Line actions: button that adds an annotation to the stated line number.

added_file.location: Stock components → Diff → File status: label identifying a file added by the patch.

added_line.location: Stock components → Diff → Line accessibility: announcement identifying an added line by side and number.

base_change.location: Stock components → Diff → Merge conflicts: heading for content from the common ancestor version.

binary_changes.location: Stock components → Diff → File status: message shown when a binary file differs between versions.

collapse_file.location: Stock components → Diff → File header: button that collapses the named file's changes.

conflicted_file.location: Stock components → Diff → Merge conflicts: label identifying a file with unresolved conflicts.

copied_file.location: Stock components → Diff → File status: label identifying a file copied by the patch.

current_change.location: Stock components → Diff → Merge conflicts: heading for the change from the current branch.

deleted_file.location: Stock components → Diff → File status: label identifying a file deleted by the patch.

empty_file.location: Stock components → Diff → File status: message shown for a file with no content.

expand_above.location: Stock components → Diff → Hunk controls: button that reveals the stated number of lines above the visible hunk.

expand_below.location: Stock components → Diff → Hunk controls: button that reveals the stated number of lines below the visible hunk.

expand_file.location: Stock components → Diff → File header: button that expands the named file's changes.

expand_lines.location: Stock components → Diff → Hunk controls: button that reveals the stated number of unchanged lines.

hidden_lines.value: %{count} lignes non incluses dans le correctif
hidden_lines.location: Stock components → Diff → Omitted content: status giving the number of unchanged lines excluded from the patch.

incoming_change.location: Stock components → Diff → Merge conflicts: heading for the change arriving from the other branch.

modified.location: Stock components → Diff → Comparison headers: label for the modified version of the content.

no_changes.location: Stock components → Diff → File status: empty state shown when the compared content is identical.

no_newline.value: Pas de nouvelle ligne à la fin du fichier
no_newline.location: Stock components → Diff → Line marker: notice shown when the file does not end with a newline.

no_text_changes.value: Aucun changement de texte dans ce correctif
no_text_changes.location: Stock components → Diff → Patch status: message shown when the patch contains no textual line changes.

original.location: Stock components → Diff → Comparison headers: label for the original version of the content.

removed_line.location: Stock components → Diff → Line accessibility: announcement identifying a removed line by side and number.

renamed_file.location: Stock components → Diff → File status: label identifying a file renamed by the patch.

select_line.location: Stock components → Diff → Line actions: accessible command that selects the stated side and line number.

source_line.location: Stock components → Diff → Line accessibility: announcement identifying the side and number of a source line.

unchanged_lines.location: Stock components → Diff → Collapsed content: label giving the number of unchanged lines in a collapsed region.

undo_resolution.location: Stock components → Diff → Merge conflict actions: button that undoes the selected conflict resolution.

viewer.location: Stock components → Diff → Viewer: accessible title for the diff of the named file.

viewer_files.location: Stock components → Diff → Viewer: accessible title for a diff containing the stated number of files.

close.location: Stock components → Dock → Panel menu: command that closes the selected panel.

collapse.location: Stock components → Dock → Panel menu: command that collapses the selected panel.

expand.location: Stock components → Dock → Panel menu: command that expands the selected collapsed panel.

unnamed.location: Stock components → Dock → Panel: fallback title for a panel that has no name.

zoom_in.location: Stock components → Dock → Panel menu: command that enlarges the selected panel.

zoom_out.location: Stock components → Dock → Panel menu: command that restores the selected panel from its enlarged state.

more_options.location: Stock components → Dropdown button: accessible label for the button that opens additional options.

copy.location: Stock components → Input → Context menu: command that copies the selected text to the clipboard.

cut.location: Stock components → Input → Context menu: command that cuts the selected text to the clipboard.

decrement.location: Stock components → Number input: accessible label for the button that decreases the value.

go_to_definition.location: Stock components → Code input → Context menu: command that navigates to the selected symbol definition.

increment.location: Stock components → Number input: accessible label for the button that increases the value.

paste.location: Stock components → Input → Context menu: command that pastes clipboard text at the insertion point.

replace.location: Stock components → Input → Find and replace: button that replaces the current match.

replace_all.location: Stock components → Input → Find and replace: button that replaces every match.

select_all.location: Stock components → Input → Context menu: command that selects all text in the field.

show_code_actions.location: Stock components → Code input → Context menu: command that opens actions available for the current code location.

search_placeholder.location: Stock components → List → Search field: placeholder for filtering the list items.

next.location: Stock components → Pagination: accessible label for the button that opens the next page.

previous.location: Stock components → Pagination: accessible label for the button that opens the previous page.

optional.value: Choisissez une réponse ou passez cette question.
optional.location: Stock components → Questionnaire → Validation: inline guidance shown when an optional question needs an answer or an explicit skip.

required.location: Stock components → Questionnaire → Validation: inline error shown when a required question has no answer.

next.location: Stock components → Questionnaire → Navigation: button that advances to the next question.

previous.location: Stock components → Questionnaire → Navigation: button that returns to the previous question.

progress.location: Stock components → Questionnaire → Progress: status giving the current question number and total question count.

skip.location: Stock components → Questionnaire → Navigation: button that skips the current optional question.

submit.location: Stock components → Questionnaire → Final actions: button that submits the completed answers.

placeholder.location: Stock components → Select: placeholder shown when the dropdown has no selected value.

reset_all.location: Stock components → Settings → Actions: button that restores every setting to its default value.

search_placeholder.location: Stock components → Settings → Search field: placeholder for filtering available settings.

start.location: Stock components → Speech input: button that starts dictation into the active field.

stop.location: Stock components → Speech input: button that stops the active dictation session.

unavailable.location: Stock components → Speech input: status shown when dictation cannot be used on this system.

sort_by.location: Stock components → Table → Column header: accessible sort command naming the column to sort.

aws_iam.location: Connection dialog → Authentication: option button in the authentication mode row that signs in with an AWS IAM token (Amazon RDS IAM authentication) instead of a password.

google_iam.location: Connection dialog → Authentication: option button in the authentication mode row that signs in with Google Cloud SQL IAM credentials instead of a password.

microsoft_entra.location: Connection dialog → Authentication: option button in the authentication mode row that signs in through a Microsoft Entra (Azure AD) account in the browser; product name.

sql_login.location: Connection dialog → Authentication: option button in the authentication mode row for a database user name and password login.

token.location: Connection dialog → Authentication: option button in the authentication mode row for engines that authenticate with an access token instead of a user name and password.

windows.location: Connection dialog → Authentication: option button in the authentication mode row for Windows integrated authentication using the current OS account; platform name.

account_not_registered.value: Le compte Microsoft Entra lié à {profile_name} n'est pas enregistré. Ouvrez Connexion Azure SQL… et connectez-vous, puis réessayez.
account_not_registered.location: Connecting → Microsoft Entra sign-in: connection error when the Entra account chosen for connection {profile_name} is no longer signed in to SQLLY; “Azure SQL Connection…” is the Tools menu command.

browser_signin_discovery_unavailable.value: La connexion et la découverte Azure ne sont pas disponibles
browser_signin_discovery_unavailable.location: Browser preview → Azure SQL and Entra features: error shown when any Azure sign-in, server discovery or firewall request is attempted in the web version, which cannot make those calls.

generic_permission_account.location: Connection dialog → Azure SQL access help: fallback account name inserted into the copied “ask my admin for access” message when no Entra account is selected; first-person.

keychain_access_denied.value: L'accès au trousseau système a été refusé. Connectez-vous à nouveau pour actualiser le jeton en mémoire pour cette session.
keychain_access_denied.location: Connecting → Microsoft Entra token storage: error when the OS keychain refused to read or delete the saved Entra token; the user must sign in again for this session.

keychain_denied_earlier.value: L'accès au trousseau système a été refusé plus tôt dans cette session. Connectez-vous à nouveau pour actualiser le jeton en mémoire.
keychain_denied_earlier.location: Connecting → Microsoft Entra token storage: error on later token reads after keychain access was already refused once this session; the user must sign in again.

public_ip_request_failed.value: Impossible de demander votre adresse IP publique : {error}
public_ip_request_failed.location: Add My IP to Server Firewall → Public IP lookup: error detail when the request to the public IP echo service fails, e.g. offline; {error} is the network error text.

public_ip_response_read_failed.value: Impossible de lire la réponse de l'IP publique : {error}
public_ip_response_read_failed.location: Add My IP to Server Firewall → Public IP lookup: error detail when the echo service answered but its reply could not be read; {error} is the technical reason.

public_ip_unexpected_response.location: Add My IP to Server Firewall → Public IP lookup: error detail when the echo service replied with something that is not an IPv4 address; {response} is the quoted reply text.

registry_io_error.location: Azure SQL Connection → Signed-in Entra accounts: error when the saved accounts list file cannot be read or written on disk; “I/O” means input/output, {error} is the system error.

registry_json_error.location: Azure SQL Connection → Signed-in Entra accounts: error when the saved accounts list file is corrupt and cannot be parsed as JSON; {error} is the parser message.

session_expired.value: La connexion Microsoft Entra pour {profile_name} est requise ou a expiré. Ouvrez la connexion Azure SQL… et connectez-vous, puis réessayez.
session_expired.location: Connecting → Microsoft Entra sign-in: connection error when connection {profile_name} needs a fresh Entra sign-in or the session expired; “Azure SQL Connection…” is the Tools menu command.

sql_token_failed.value: Impossible d'obtenir le jeton d'accès Azure SQL : {error}
sql_token_failed.location: Connecting → Microsoft Entra sign-in: connection error when SQLLY cannot get an Azure SQL access token from the signed-in account; {error} is the underlying reason.

default_aws_profile.location: Connection dialog → Authentication → AWS IAM: first option in the AWS profile dropdown, meaning the default AWS credential chain rather than a named profile; keep the parentheses.

profile_not_configured.value: Le profil n'est pas configuré pour l'authentification IAM cloud
profile_not_configured.location: Connecting → Cloud IAM authentication (AWS or Google): lowercase error fragment when a connection set to IAM sign-in lacks the settings needed to create a token.

browser_session_read_failed.value: Impossible de lire le mot de passe enregistré à partir de cette session de navigateur : {detail}
browser_session_read_failed.location: Browser preview → Connecting to a saved connection → Loading saved credentials: error shown when the browser's session storage cannot be read to load a saved SQL password; {detail} is the browser's own error text and stays untranslated.

default_database.location: Export Connections dialog → Server and database tree → Database row: label shown for a connection that has no database set, meaning it opens the server’s default database; written in parentheses as a placeholder name.

export_clear_selection.location: Export Connections dialog → Toolbar above the server tree: short button label shown when every connection is selected; clicking it unticks all servers and databases. Imperative verb, tight space.

export_database_count.location: Export Connections dialog → Server and database tree → Server row: dim note beside a server with two or more databases when all or none of them are ticked; {count} is the number of databases under that server.

export_many_connections_button.location: Export Connections dialog → Footer: primary button when zero or two or more connections are ticked; {count} is the number ticked. Clicking it opens the save-file prompt, hence the trailing ellipsis. Plural form.

export_one_connection_button.location: Export Connections dialog → Footer: primary button when exactly one connection is ticked; {count} is always 1. Clicking it opens the save-file prompt, hence the trailing ellipsis. Singular form.

export_one_database.location: Export Connections dialog → Server and database tree → Server row: dim note beside a server that has exactly one database, shown instead of a count. Singular form of the per-server database count.

export_secret_material_refused.value: Refus d’écrire une exportation de connexion contenant du matériel secret
export_secret_material_refused.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when Export Connections (the no-passwords variant) detects a password or token in the file it built and refuses to save it; a safety check, no file is written.

export_select_all.location: Export Connections dialog → Toolbar above the server tree: short button label shown when not every connection is selected; clicking it ticks all servers and databases. Imperative verb, tight space.

export_server_partial_selected.location: Export Connections dialog → Server and database tree → Server row: dim note beside a server when only some of its databases are ticked; {count} is the number ticked, {total} the server’s database count.

export_total_selected.location: Export Connections dialog → Toolbar above the server tree: overall selection summary at the left; {count} is how many connections are ticked across all servers, {total} is how many connections exist.

export_warning_body.value: Chaque mot de passe, phrase secrète et jeton pour les connexions que vous choisissez est écrit dans le fichier en clair. Toute personne obtenant le fichier peut se connecter à ces bases de données, donc stockez-le dans un endroit privé, partagez-le uniquement avec les personnes qui devraient avoir ces identifiants, et supprimez-le une fois qu'il a été importé.
export_warning_body.location: Export Conn w/ Creds dialog → Warning banner at top: explanatory paragraph under the clear-text warning heading, telling the user passwords and tokens are written unencrypted and how to keep the file safe.

export_warning_title.value: Ce fichier contiendra les mots de passe en texte clair
export_warning_title.location: Export Conn w/ Creds dialog → Warning banner at top: bold warning heading above the tree, shown only when exporting connections with their passwords; warns that the saved file holds passwords unencrypted.

export_with_secrets_title.location: Export Conn w/ Creds dialog → Title bar: window title of the picker opened from File ▸ Export Conn w/ Creds, which exports connections including their passwords. Deliberately abbreviated (“Conn” = connections, “Creds” = credentials); keep it short.

export_without_secrets_body.value: Choisissez les serveurs et les bases de données à exporter. Le fichier contient leurs paramètres, ainsi que les identifiants partagés, les profils de tunnel et les couleurs et icônes utilisées pour les clients, projets et environnements, mais aucun mot de passe : chacun est demandé lors de la première connexion après l'importation.
export_without_secrets_body.location: Export Connections dialog → Intro note above the tree: instructions shown when exporting without passwords, listing what the file includes (settings, shared logins, tunnels, labels) and that passwords are asked for on import.

export_without_secrets_title.location: Export Connections dialog → Title bar: window title of the server and database picker opened from File ▸ Export Connections, which saves connection settings to a file without any passwords.

export_for_tool_title.location: Export for Other Tools dialog → Title: dialog title naming the database tool the connection file is being written for; {tool} is a product name such as pgAdmin or DBeaver, left untranslated.

export_for_tool_body.value: Choisissez les serveurs et les bases de données à enregistrer en tant que fichier {file_name} que {tool} peut importer. Le fichier ne contient aucun mot de passe, et seules les connexions {tool} peuvent ouvrir y sont listées.
