month_october_abbreviated.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: short month name for October, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the abbreviated month name; keep it about three characters.

month_september.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: full month name for September, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the full month name (for example a long date such as “3 September 2024”).

month_september_abbreviated.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Date cells: short month name for September, inserted where a date column's display pattern asks for the abbreviated month name; keep it about three characters.

unknown_day.location: SQLLY → Results → Date-formatted cell → Invalid weekday: fallback name for an invalid day component.

unknown_month.location: SQLLY → Results → Date-formatted cell → Invalid month: fallback name for an invalid month component.

billions.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Numeric cells with abbreviated (metric) formatting: compact number for values in the billions (thousand millions), {value} is the scaled number and “G” the short magnitude suffix (4 000 000 000 shown as 4G); keep the suffix very short.

millions.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Numeric cells with abbreviated (metric) formatting: compact number for values in the millions, {value} is the scaled number and “M” the short magnitude suffix (2 300 000 shown as 2.3M); keep the suffix very short.

quadrillions.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Numeric cells with abbreviated (metric) formatting: compact number for values in the quadrillions and larger, {value} is the scaled number and “P” the short magnitude suffix (10¹⁵ range and above); keep the suffix very short.

thousands.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Numeric cells with abbreviated (metric) formatting: compact number for values in the thousands, {value} is the scaled number and “K” the short magnitude suffix (1 500 shown as 1.5K); keep the suffix very short.

trillions.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Numeric cells with abbreviated (metric) formatting: compact number for values in the trillions (million millions), {value} is the scaled number and “T” the short magnitude suffix (10¹² range); keep the suffix very short.

component_separator.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: connector placed between two duration parts, as in “2 days and 3 hours”; include surrounding spaces as your language needs.

day_plural.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: day unit word used after any count other than 1, as in “5 days ago”; the number is placed before it.

day_singular.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: day unit word used after the number 1, as in “1 day ago”; the number is placed before it.

future.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: full text for a date in the future, {duration} is the number-plus-unit phrase such as “2 days and 3 hours”.

hour_plural.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: hour unit word used after any count other than 1, as in “5 hours ago”; the number is placed before it.

hour_singular.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: hour unit word used after the number 1, as in “1 hour ago”; the number is placed before it.

minute_plural.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: minute unit word used after any count other than 1, as in “5 minutes ago”; the number is placed before it.

minute_singular.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: minute unit word used after the number 1, as in “1 minute ago”; the number is placed before it.

month_plural.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: month unit word used after any count other than 1, as in “5 months ago”; the number is placed before it.

month_singular.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: month unit word used after the number 1, as in “1 month ago”; the number is placed before it.

now.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: text shown instead of a duration when the date equals the current moment (less than the smallest displayed unit away).

past.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: full text for a date in the past, {duration} is the number-plus-unit phrase such as “2 days and 3 hours”.

second_plural.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: second unit word used after any count other than 1, as in “5 seconds ago”; the number is placed before it.

second_singular.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: second unit word used after the number 1, as in “1 second ago”; the number is placed before it.

week_plural.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: week unit word used after any count other than 1, as in “5 weeks ago”; the number is placed before it.

week_singular.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: week unit word used after the number 1, as in “1 week ago”; the number is placed before it.

year_plural.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: year unit word used after any count other than 1, as in “5 years ago”; the number is placed before it.

year_singular.location: Results → Grid and Pivot tabs → Relative-time date cells: year unit word used after the number 1, as in “1 year ago”; the number is placed before it.

clear_filter.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: last menu item, removes any filter applied to the right-clicked column so all its rows show again.

clear_grouping.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that removes row grouping and returns to a flat list of rows.

clear_sort.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that removes the current sort and restores the original row order.

copy_column.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that copies the right-clicked column's values to the clipboard without its header name.

copy_column_with_headers.value: Copier la colonne avec les en-têtes
copy_column_with_headers.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that copies the right-clicked column's values to the clipboard with the column name as the first line.

filter_prompt.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item near the bottom that opens the column's sort-and-filter panel; the trailing dots signal that a panel follows.

freeze_columns_up_to_here.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that pins every column from the left edge through this one so they stay visible while scrolling sideways; title-case command.

group_by_column.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that groups the rows into collapsible sections by the values of the right-clicked column.

hide_column.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that hides the right-clicked column from the grid.

move_column_left.value: Déplacer la colonne vers la gauche
move_column_left.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that swaps the right-clicked column one position to the left.

move_column_right.value: Déplacer la colonne vers la droite
move_column_right.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that swaps the right-clicked column one position to the right.

select_column.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: first menu item, selects every cell of the right-clicked column.

show_all_columns.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that brings back every previously hidden column.

sort_ascending.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that sorts all rows by this column, smallest or A–Z first.

sort_descending.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that sorts all rows by this column, largest or Z–A first.

unfreeze_columns.location: Results → Grid tab → Column header right-click menu: menu item that releases all pinned (frozen) columns so they scroll normally again.

ragged_row.value: La ligne {row_index} a {actual} cellules mais {expected} étaient attendues
ragged_row.location: SQLLY → Results → Grid → Data validation: error shown when a row does not match the column count.

banner.location: Results → Grid tab → Pivot drill-through banner: strip above the grid after drilling into a pivot cell, telling the user the grid is filtered; {filter_label} is the comma-separated list of column = value conditions.

clear_filter.location: Results → Grid tab → Pivot drill-through banner: clickable button with an X icon at the right end of the banner that removes the drill-through filter and shows all rows again.

field_equals.location: Results → Grid tab → Pivot drill-through banner: one condition inside the banner's filter list; {field_name} is the column name and {values} the matching value or values joined by a vertical bar.

values_omitted.location: Results → Grid tab → Pivot drill-through banner: shortened value list used when a condition has more than three values; {values} are the first two values and {value_count} the total number of values.

no_rows.location: SQLLY → Results → Grid → Empty result area: message shown when no rows are available.

clear_filter.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: bottom-left button that removes this column's filter; greyed out and inactive when no filter is applied.

close.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: bottom-right button that closes the panel and keeps whatever sort or filter was set.

date_operand_placeholder.location: SQLLY → Results → Grid → Column filter panel: placeholder in the date operand placeholder input.

filter_heading.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: small muted section heading above the condition dropdown, search box and value checklist; a noun.

number_operand_placeholder.location: SQLLY → Results → Grid → Column filter panel: placeholder in the number operand placeholder input.

number_operator_between.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for numeric and date columns that keeps rows inside a range and shows two input boxes joined by “and”; lowercase phrase completing “value is …”.

number_operator_choose_one.location: SQLLY → Results → Grid → Column filter panel → Numeric operator menu: Choose One placeholder option.

number_operator_equal_to.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for numeric and date columns that keeps rows whose value equals the entered number; lowercase phrase completing “value is …”.

number_operator_greater_than.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for numeric and date columns that keeps rows whose value is above the entered number; lowercase phrase completing “value is …”.

number_operator_greater_than_or_equal_to.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for numeric and date columns that keeps rows whose value is at or above the entered number; lowercase phrase completing “value is …”.

number_operator_less_than.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for numeric and date columns that keeps rows whose value is below the entered number; lowercase phrase completing “value is …”.

number_operator_less_than_or_equal_to.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for numeric and date columns that keeps rows whose value is at or below the entered number; lowercase phrase completing “value is …”.

number_operator_not_between.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for numeric and date columns that keeps rows outside a range and shows two input boxes joined by “and”; lowercase phrase completing “value is …”.

number_operator_not_equal_to.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for numeric and date columns that keeps rows whose value differs from the entered number; lowercase phrase completing “value is …”.

refine_search.value: Affiner la recherche pour en voir plus…
refine_search.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: muted note at the end of the value checklist when more than 200 distinct values match, asking the user to type in the search box to narrow the list.

regex_operand_placeholder.location: SQLLY → Results → Grid → Column filter panel: placeholder in the regex operand placeholder input.

search_placeholder.location: SQLLY → Results → Grid → Column filter panel: placeholder in the search placeholder input.

second_operand_and.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: small muted word between the two input boxes shown when the “between” or “not between” condition is chosen, linking the lower and upper bounds.

select_all.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: first row of the distinct-values checklist, with a checkbox that checks or unchecks every listed value; parentheses mark it as a special entry, not a data value.

sort_ascending.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: left button under the Sort heading that sorts rows by this column smallest or A–Z first; highlighted while active.

sort_descending.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: right button under the Sort heading that sorts rows by this column largest or Z–A first; highlighted while active.

sort_heading.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: small muted section heading at the top of the panel, above the Ascending and Descending buttons; a noun.

text_operand_placeholder.location: SQLLY → Results → Grid → Column filter panel: placeholder in the text operand placeholder input.

text_operator_begins_with.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for text columns that keeps rows whose text starts with the entered text; lowercase phrase following the column value.

text_operator_choose_one.location: SQLLY → Results → Grid → Column filter panel → Text operator menu: Choose One placeholder option.

text_operator_contains.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for text columns that keeps rows whose text includes the entered text; lowercase phrase following the column value.

text_operator_does_not_contain.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for text columns that keeps rows whose text does not include the entered text; lowercase phrase following the column value.

text_operator_ends_with.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for text columns that keeps rows whose text ends with the entered text; lowercase phrase following the column value.

text_operator_is.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for text columns that keeps rows whose text exactly equals the entered text; lowercase phrase following the column value.

text_operator_is_not.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for text columns that keeps rows whose text is anything other than the entered text; lowercase phrase following the column value.

text_operator_matches_regex.location: Results → Grid tab → Column sort-and-filter panel: condition dropdown option for text columns that keeps rows whose text matches the entered regular expression; the parenthesized word names the pattern syntax; lowercase phrase following the column value.

row_plural.location: Results → Grid tab → Grouped rows → Group header row: label for a group with zero or several rows; {marker} is the expand/collapse arrow, {group_label} the shared column value, {row_count} the number of rows (not 1).

row_singular.location: Results → Grid tab → Grouped rows → Group header row: label for a group containing exactly one row; {marker} is the expand/collapse arrow, {group_label} the shared column value, {row_count} is 1.

no_matches.location: Results → Grid find bar (Find in results): match counter beside the search field when the typed text matches no cell in the active grid.

position.location: Results → Grid find bar (Find in results): match counter beside the search field; {current} is the number of the highlighted match and {total} the total match count.

position_truncated.location: Results → Grid find bar (Find in results): match counter used when the scan stopped at the match limit; {current} is the highlighted match, {total} the capped count and the plus sign means more exist.

collapsed_chart.location: Results → Chart tab → Collapsed sidebar rail: vertical label on the slim strip left where the chart settings sidebar was collapsed; clicking it expands the sidebar again; very narrow space.

collapsed_pivot.location: Results → Pivot tab → Collapsed sidebar rail: vertical label on the slim strip left where the pivot field sidebar was collapsed; clicking it expands the sidebar again; very narrow space.

chart.location: Results → View tab strip above each result set: tab that shows the chart view of the same rows, present when charting is enabled; short noun.

chart_with_status.location: Results → View tab strip above each result set: Chart tab title while the tab is locked, e.g. during streaming; {status} is a short state such as “Loading...” or “Result too large”.

grid.location: Results → View tab strip above each result set: first tab, always shown, that displays the rows as a plain table; short noun.

pivot.location: Results → View tab strip above each result set: tab that shows the pivot-table view of the same rows, present when pivoting is enabled; short noun.

pivot_with_status.location: Results → View tab strip above each result set: Pivot tab title while the tab is locked, e.g. during streaming; {status} is a short state such as “Loading...” or “Result too large”.

average.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → Values zone → Aggregation dropdown: option “Avg” that summarizes the Values field as the arithmetic mean of its numbers; very short abbreviation, it also starts the “Avg of …” caption.

average_caption.location: Results → Pivot tab → Values chip, value column header and copied CSV: caption naming the average (mean) aggregation and its source column, e.g. “Avg of Amount”; {field_name} is the source column name. Keep short; it shares a narrow chip.

count.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → Values zone → Aggregation dropdown: option “Count” that summarizes the Values field as the number of source rows in each pivot cell; short noun, not a verb.

count_caption.location: Results → Pivot tab → Values chip, value column header and copied CSV: caption naming the count (number of rows) aggregation and its source column, e.g. “Count of Amount”; {field_name} is the source column name. Keep short; it shares a narrow chip.

first.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → Values zone → Aggregation dropdown: option “First” that shows the first source value found for each pivot cell instead of a calculated summary; short adjective/noun.

first_caption.location: Results → Pivot tab → Values chip, value column header and copied CSV: caption naming the first-value aggregation and its source column, e.g. “First of Amount”; {field_name} is the source column name. Keep short; it shares a narrow chip.

maximum.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → Values zone → Aggregation dropdown: option “Max” that summarizes the Values field as the largest value in each pivot cell; very short abbreviation of maximum.

maximum_caption.location: Results → Pivot tab → Values chip, value column header and copied CSV: caption naming the maximum aggregation and its source column, e.g. “Max of Amount”; {field_name} is the source column name. Keep short; it shares a narrow chip.

minimum.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → Values zone → Aggregation dropdown: option “Min” that summarizes the Values field as the smallest value in each pivot cell; very short abbreviation of minimum.

minimum_caption.location: Results → Pivot tab → Values chip, value column header and copied CSV: caption naming the minimum aggregation and its source column, e.g. “Min of Amount”; {field_name} is the source column name. Keep short; it shares a narrow chip.

sum.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → Values zone → Aggregation dropdown: option “Sum” that summarizes the Values field as the total of its numbers in each pivot cell; short noun, not a verb.

sum_caption.location: Results → Pivot tab → Values chip, value column header and copied CSV: caption naming the sum (total) aggregation and its source column, e.g. “Sum of Amount”; {field_name} is the source column name. Keep short; it shares a narrow chip.

copy_csv.value: Copier le pivot en tant que CSV
copy_csv.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot cell right-click menu: item that copies the whole pivot table (headers, rows, totals) to the clipboard as comma-separated text.

copy_value.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot cell right-click menu: item that copies only the right-clicked cell’s aggregated value to the clipboard.

show_source_rows.value: Afficher les lignes source dans la grille
show_source_rows.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot cell right-click menu: drill-through item that switches to the Grid tab filtered to the source rows behind the clicked pivot cell (same as double-clicking it).

no_matching_data.value: Aucune donnée ne correspond aux filtres de pivot actuels.
no_matching_data.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot canvas: centered message shown instead of the table when the pivot is configured but the active Filters exclude every source row.

not_configured.value: Faites glisser les champs dans Lignes, Colonnes et Valeurs pour construire le pivot.
not_configured.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot canvas: centered prompt shown before any field has been placed, telling the user to drag fields into the Rows, Columns and Values zones of the sidebar.

blank.location: SQLLY → Results → Pivot → Row or column group header: label for null or blank source values.

align_center.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup → Alignment row: middle toggle button that centers the field’s values in their cells; one short word, the three buttons share a narrow row.

align_left.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup → Alignment row: first toggle button that left-aligns the field’s values in their cells; one short word, the three buttons share a narrow row.

align_right.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup → Alignment row: last toggle button that right-aligns the field’s values in their cells; one short word, the three buttons share a narrow row.

alignment_heading.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup: small heading above the Left / Center / Right buttons that set how the double-clicked field’s values are aligned.

collapse_columns.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section → Groups: button that collapses every column group to its subtotal; abbreviated “cols” because it sits beside “Expand cols” in a narrow row.

collapse_rows.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section → Groups: button that collapses every row group to its subtotal line; sits beside “Expand rows” in a narrow row.

column_subtotals.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section → Totals: checkbox that adds a subtotal column after each column group; means “show subtotal columns for column groups”.

columns_zone.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section: title of the Columns drop zone; fields dragged here become the pivot’s column headers.

columns_zone_badge.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Fields section → Field list: one-letter badge on a source field that is currently placed in the Columns zone; must stay one or two letters.

controls_title.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar: bold title at the top of the sidebar that holds the Fields, Layout and Display and export sections.

copy_csv.value: Copier le pivot en tant que CSV
copy_csv.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section → Export: button that copies the whole pivot table to the clipboard as comma-separated text.

decimals_heading.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup: label beside the minus/plus stepper that sets how many decimal places (0–8) the field’s numbers show.

display_section.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar: title of the third collapsible section, holding the totals, group expand/collapse and CSV export options.

drag_fields_here.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section: muted placeholder inside an empty Filters, Columns, Rows or Values drop zone, inviting the user to drop a field there.

expand_columns.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section → Groups: button that expands every collapsed column group; abbreviated “cols” because it sits beside “Collapse cols” in a narrow row.

expand_rows.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section → Groups: button that expands every collapsed row group; sits beside “Collapse rows” in a narrow row.

export_heading.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section: small heading above the “Copy pivot as CSV” button.

fallback_field_name.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section: chip label used for a field placed in a zone when its source column has no name; {column_index} is the column’s zero-based position.

fields_section.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar: title of the first collapsible section, listing the result set’s columns that can be dragged into the layout zones.

filter_clear.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → Filter value popover: button at the bottom that removes this field’s filter so all its values are included again.

filter_close.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → Filter value popover: button at the bottom that closes the popover, keeping the checked values as the filter.

filter_first_values.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → Filter value popover: muted note at the end of the value checklist when the field has more distinct values than the list shows; {count} is how many are listed.

filter_select_all.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → Filter value popover: first checklist entry that checks or unchecks every value of the field at once; parentheses mark it as a special entry, not a data value.

filter_title.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → Filter value popover: heading of the popover opened by clicking a chip in the Filters zone; {field_name} is the column being filtered.

filters_zone.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section: title of the Filters drop zone; fields dragged here can be clicked to choose which of their values the pivot includes.

filters_zone_badge.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Fields section → Field list: short badge on a source field that is currently placed in the Filters zone; must stay one or two letters and differ from the other zone badges.

flat_rows.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section → Layout: checkbox that shows the row fields side by side as flat columns instead of an indented, collapsible hierarchy.

format_close.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup: button at the bottom that closes the popup, keeping the format changes already applied.

format_reset.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup: button at the bottom that restores the field’s default number format and alignment.

format_title.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup: heading of the popup opened by double-clicking a field chip in a layout zone; {field_name} is the column being formatted.

grand_total_column.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section → Totals: checkbox that shows a grand-total column at the right edge of the pivot.

grand_total_row.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section → Totals: checkbox that shows a grand-total row at the bottom of the pivot.

groups_heading.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section: small heading above the Expand/Collapse rows and columns buttons that open or fold all group levels.

layout_heading.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section: small heading above the “Flat rows (no hierarchy)” checkbox; distinct from the Layout section title.

layout_section.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar: title of the second collapsible section, holding the Filters, Columns, Rows and Values drop zones and the save-configuration icon.

negative_example_minus.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup → Negatives row: button showing a sample negative number with a leading minus sign; picks that style. Localize only digit grouping, not the digits.

negative_example_parentheses.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup → Negatives row: button showing a sample negative number in accounting parentheses; picks that style. Localize only digit grouping, not the digits.

negative_numbers_in_red.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup: checkbox that paints the field’s negative values in red.

negatives_heading.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup: small heading above the two sample buttons that choose how negative numbers are written (minus sign or parentheses).

row_subtotals.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section → Totals: checkbox that adds a subtotal row after each row group.

rows_zone.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section: title of the Rows drop zone; fields dragged here become the pivot’s row headers (nested groups).

rows_zone_badge.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Fields section → Field list: short badge on a source field that is currently placed in the Rows zone; must stay one or two letters and differ from the other zone badges.

save_configuration.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section → section header: tooltip on the disk icon that saves the current pivot layout (fields, aggregation, options) so it can be reused; only present when the app supports saving.

thousands_separator.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Field format popup: checkbox that groups the field’s digits with a thousands separator (e.g. 1,234).

totals_heading.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Display and export section: small heading above the subtotal and grand-total checkboxes.

unconfigured_hint.value: Glisser un champ dans une zone de mise en page
unconfigured_hint.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Fields section: muted hint above the field list telling the user to drag a column into one of the Filters, Columns, Rows or Values zones.

values_zone.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Layout section: title of the Values drop zone; the field dragged here is summarized (Count, Sum, Avg…) in the pivot’s cells.

values_zone_badge.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot Controls sidebar → Fields section → Field list: one-letter badge on a source field that is currently placed in the Values zone; must stay one or two letters.

grand_total.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot table and copied CSV: label of the grand-total row at the bottom and grand-total column at the right, summing every group.

group_total.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot table and copied CSV: label of a subtotal row or column, or of a collapsed group; {group_label} is the group’s value, e.g. “2024 Total”.

total.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot table and copied CSV: label of the single summary row when no row fields are placed, or a subtotal column whose group name is unknown.

caption.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot table: generic value column header shown when no field is in the Values zone, so the cells hold only row counts.

fallback_field_name.location: Results → Pivot tab → Pivot table value header: name used inside the “Sum of …” caption when the Values field’s source column has no name; {column_index} is its zero-based position.

close.location: Dialogs (shared frame) → Footer: default Close button at the bottom right of dialogs that have no custom buttons; dismisses the dialog.

pop_out.location: Dialogs (shared frame) → Title bar: small button on detachable dialogs that moves the dialog out of the main window into its own separate window; keep the ⤢ arrow symbol.

sandbox_blocked.value: {feature} n'est pas disponible dans l'édition SQLLY du Mac App Store, car le sandbox de l'App Store n'autorise pas le lancement de programmes installés sur votre Mac. Voir Aide ▸ Édition Mac App Store pour les différences.
sandbox_blocked.location: Mac App Store edition → Sandbox limitation error: feature-specific message explaining why launching an installed program is unavailable and where to read edition differences.

add_foreign_key_join.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → SQL-aware actions: item that inserts a JOIN to the table referenced by the clicked column’s foreign key.

automagic_commas_disable.value: Désactiver les virgules Automagic {clause} pour cette requête
automagic_commas_disable.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → Automagic submenu: item that turns off automatic comma repair for one clause in this query only; {clause} is the SQL clause keyword, e.g. SELECT or ORDER BY.

automagic_commas_enable.value: Activer les virgules Automagic {clause} pour cette requête
automagic_commas_enable.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → Automagic submenu: item that turns on automatic comma repair for one clause in this query only; {clause} is the SQL clause keyword, e.g. SELECT or ORDER BY.

automagic_commas_reset.value: Réinitialiser les paramètres de virgule Automagic dans les Préférences
automagic_commas_reset.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → Automagic submenu: item that drops this query’s comma overrides so the Settings defaults apply again.

automagic_connectors_disable.value: Désactiver les connecteurs WHERE/ON Automagic pour cette requête
automagic_connectors_disable.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → Automagic submenu: item that turns off automatic AND/OR connector repair in WHERE and ON clauses for this query only.

automagic_connectors_enable.value: Activer les connecteurs WHERE/ON Automagic pour cette requête
automagic_connectors_enable.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → Automagic submenu: item that turns on automatic AND/OR connector repair in WHERE and ON clauses for this query only.

automagic_submenu.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → Automagic submenu: submenu title grouping the per-query toggles of the Automagic comma and connector repairs; Automagic is the feature name.

expand_wildcard.value: Développer le caractère générique en noms de colonnes
expand_wildcard.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → SQL-aware actions: item shown on a SELECT * that replaces the asterisk with the explicit list of column names.

format_column.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → SQL-aware actions: item that opens the Format column dialog for the clicked column; {column} is the column name; the ellipsis signals that a dialog opens.

identity_insert_on.value: Activer IDENTITY_INSERT pour {table} autour de cet INSERT
identity_insert_on.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → SQL-aware actions: item on a SQL Server INSERT into an identity table that wraps the statement in SET IDENTITY_INSERT ON/OFF; {table} is the table name; IDENTITY_INSERT and INSERT are SQL keywords.

qualify_identifier.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → SQL-aware actions: item that prefixes the clicked column with its table or alias; {qualifier} is that table or alias and {column} the column name, shown as written in SQL.

qualify_selection_many.value: Qualifier les colonnes {count} dans la sélection
qualify_selection_many.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → SQL-aware actions: item that prefixes every unqualified column in the selection with its table or alias; {count} is the number of columns (2 or more).

qualify_selection_one.value: Qualifier la colonne {count} dans la sélection
qualify_selection_one.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → SQL-aware actions: item that prefixes the single unqualified column in the selection with its table or alias; {count} is always 1.

remove_qualifier.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → SQL-aware actions: item that removes the table or alias prefix from the clicked column; {column} is the column name.

show_display_name.location: SQL editor → Right-click context menu → SQL-aware actions: item that adds the referenced table’s human-readable display column for the clicked foreign-key column.

column_inferred.location: SQL Editor → Natural-date helper card (Ctrl+Shift+Space after a comparison on a date column): column description when the column has no known type but its name suggests a date; {column} is the column as written.

column_typed.location: SQL Editor → Natural-date helper card: column description when the column’s declared type is known; {column} is the column as written and {parameter_type} its SQL type, e.g. “OrderDate (datetime)”.

empty_phrase_hint.value: Entrée inscrit la date et garde vos mots dans un commentaire --sqlly date · Échap annule
empty_phrase_hint.location: SQL Editor → Natural-date helper card: last line before anything is typed, explaining that Enter inserts the date plus a “--sqlly date:” comment keeping the phrase, and Esc closes the card; keep “--sqlly date:” verbatim.

for_column.location: SQL Editor → Natural-date helper card → first line: dimmed fragment appended after “Type a date in plain words”; {column} is the column description. Starts with a space and continues that sentence.

insert_hint.value: Entrée pour insérer · Échap pour annuler
insert_hint.location: SQL Editor → Natural-date helper card: last line shown once the typed phrase is understood, under the preview of the resulting SQL; Enter inserts it, Esc cancels.

instruction.value: Tapez une date en mots simples
instruction.location: SQL Editor → Natural-date helper card: bold first line telling the user to type a date phrase such as “last wed at 3” or “ytd”; followed by the dimmed “for {column}” fragment.

unrecognized_phrase.value: “{phrase}” n'est pas encore une date que je peux lire — essayez :
unrecognized_phrase.location: SQL Editor → Date Helper: message or display text shown as ““{phrase}” isn't a date I can read yet — try:”.

current_monitor_label.location: Go to definition (Cmd/Ctrl-click) → Definition popup placement: name for the monitor holding the active SQLLY window, used when the popup opens there; {resolution} is width×height in pixels.

monitor_label.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation → Popup window → Monitor dropdown: option naming one connected display; {number} is its 1-based position and {resolution} its width×height in pixels.

copy_button.location: Definition viewer (Cmd/Ctrl-click an object; tab, side panel or popup) → Header: button that copies the shown DDL source to the clipboard.

find_close.location: Definition viewer → find bar: tooltip of the ✕ button that closes the find bar (also Escape).

find_next.location: Definition viewer → find bar: tooltip of the down-arrow button that moves to the next match (also Enter).

find_previous.location: Definition viewer → find bar: tooltip of the up-arrow button that moves to the previous match (also Shift+Enter).

find_placeholder.location: Definition viewer → find bar: placeholder in the search field.

find_button.location: Definition viewer (read-only DDL tab, side panel or popup) → header toolbar: button that opens the find bar to search the shown definition.

header_subtitle.location: Definition viewer → Header: dimmed line under the object name; {role} is what was clicked (table, column X…), {source} the definition source, {database} and {connection} where it came from.

loading.location: Definition viewer → Body: centered placeholder shown while the object’s DDL is being fetched from the server.

no_source.value: Aucune source DDL n'a été renvoyée pour cet objet.
no_source.location: Definition viewer → Body: warning shown when the server answered but returned no DDL text for the clicked object.

open_query_button.location: Definition viewer → Header: button that copies the shown DDL into a new, editable query tab.

role_column.location: Definition viewer → Header subtitle: role part when the user Cmd/Ctrl-clicked a table column; {name} is the column name. Lowercase noun phrase.

role_function.location: Definition viewer → Header subtitle: role part when the clicked object is a function. Single lowercase noun.

role_index.location: Definition viewer → Header subtitle: role part when the user Cmd/Ctrl-clicked an index name; {name} is the index name. Lowercase noun phrase.

role_parameter.location: Definition viewer → Header subtitle: role part when the user Cmd/Ctrl-clicked a stored-procedure parameter; {name} is the parameter name. Lowercase noun phrase.

role_procedure.location: Definition viewer → Header subtitle: role part when the clicked object is a stored procedure. Single lowercase noun.

role_table.location: Definition viewer → Header subtitle: role part when the clicked object is a table (not a column or index of it). Single lowercase noun.

role_type.location: Definition viewer → Header subtitle: role part when the clicked object is a user-defined data type. Single lowercase noun.

role_view.location: Definition viewer → Header subtitle: role part when the clicked object is a database view. Single lowercase noun.

directive_hover_action.value: Cliquez pour voir toutes les options de formatage →
directive_hover_action.location: SQL Editor → Hover popup over a “-- sqlly” formatting comment: second, accent-colored clickable line that opens the full formatting-directives reference.

directive_hover_explanation.value: Ce commentaire contrôle la façon dont SQLLY formate ces résultats.
directive_hover_explanation.location: SQL Editor → Hover popup over a “-- sqlly” formatting comment: first line explaining that the comment controls how the query’s results are formatted.

improve_hint_prefix.location: SQL Editor → Completion popup → bottom hint strip: lowercase text placed directly before an “F2” keycap, inviting the user to report bad suggestions; sentence fragment ending at the key.

more_lines.location: SQL Editor → Folded region hover preview: last line of the preview when the folded block is longer than the lines shown; {count} is the number of hidden lines.

no_suggestions.value: Aucune suggestion — appuyez sur F2 pour aider à améliorer ceci
no_suggestions.location: SQL Editor → Completion popup: empty-state text shown when IntelliSense has no suggestions at the caret; F2 opens the feedback report. Keep “F2”.

refresh_date.location: SQL Editor → Inline chip at the end of a line with a “--sqlly date:” comment: clickable chip that re-evaluates the statement’s single natural-language date against today.

refresh_dates.location: SQL Editor → Inline chip at the end of a statement line: clickable chip that re-evaluates all of the statement’s natural-language dates against today; {count} is how many (2 or more).

see_formatting_directives.value: Voir les directives de formatage SQLLY →
see_formatting_directives.location: SQL Editor → Diagnostic hover popup on a problem inside a “-- sqlly” comment: accent-colored link line that opens the formatting-directives reference.

count.location: SQL Editor → Find and Replace bar: match counter beside the search box; {current} is the selected match’s number and {total} the number of matches.

count_truncated.location: SQL Editor → Find and Replace bar: match counter when the search stopped at the match limit; {total} is the limit and the “+” means there are more.

no_matches.location: SQL Editor → Find and Replace bar: counter text beside the search box when the search text is not found in the editor.

pattern_too_large.value: le modèle est plus grand que la limite de {limit_kib} Ko
pattern_too_large.location: SQL Editor → Find and Replace bar: inline error when Regex mode is on and the pattern exceeds the size limit; {limit_kib} is the limit in kibibytes. Lowercase sentence fragment.

binary_base64.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: binary column option showing the bytes as Base64; Base64 is a technical name.

binary_hex.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: binary column option showing the bytes as hexadecimal.

binary_ulid.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: binary column option showing 16-byte values as a ULID (26-character sortable id); other lengths stay hexadecimal. ULID is a technical name.

binary_uuid.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: binary column option showing 16-byte values as a hyphenated UUID; other lengths stay hexadecimal. UUID is a technical name.

boolean_one_zero.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: true/false column option showing 1 and 0.

boolean_true_false.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: true/false column option showing the words true and false; keep the words lowercase.

boolean_yes_no.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: true/false column option showing Yes and No; the rendered cells use the English words Yes/No, so keep them.

custom.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: last option, available for every column type, that opens a custom formatter instead of a preset; the ellipsis signals more input follows.

date_only.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: date/time column option showing only the date; the example date in parentheses shows the format.

date_time.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: date/time column option showing the date and time of day.

date_time_offset.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: date/time column option showing the date, time of day, and UTC offset.

decimals_four.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: decimal column option rounding to four decimal places with thousands separators.

decimals_no_grouping.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: decimal column option with two decimal places and no thousands separators.

decimals_six.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: decimal column option rounding to six decimal places with thousands separators.

decimals_two.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: decimal column option rounding to two decimal places with thousands separators.

epoch_milliseconds.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: whole-number column option reading the value as Unix epoch milliseconds and showing it as a date and time.

epoch_seconds.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: whole-number column option reading the value as Unix epoch seconds and showing it as a date and time.

integer_plain.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: whole-number column option shown without separators.

integer_thousands.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: whole-number column option adding thousands separators.

text_lowercase.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: text column option that shows the text in lowercase.

text_mask_all.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: text column option that hides every character.

text_mask_last_four.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: text column option that hides all but the last four characters, e.g. for card numbers.

text_original.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: text column option that leaves the text unchanged.

text_uppercase.location: SQL editor → Format column dialog (from the editor or a result column) → Choice list: text column option that shows the text in uppercase.

clear_filter.value: Effacez le filtre pour voir toutes les familles {count}.
clear_filter.location: Formatting Directives window → Detail pane: centered empty-state hint shown on the right when the filter matches nothing; {count} is the total number of directive families available.

copied_button.location: Formatting Directives window → Directive card → Examples: chip text shown for about 1.6 seconds after an example line is copied, confirming it is on the clipboard; past participle, very short.

copy_button.location: Formatting Directives window → Directive card → Examples: small chip at the right edge of each example line, idle state; clicking the line copies it to the clipboard (verb).

canvas_dimensions.value: Les dimensions du canevas, par ex. 2x2 (première ligne non vide uniquement).
canvas_dimensions.location: Formatting Directives window → Canvas layout directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “<rows>x<columns>” parameter; the canvas size such as 2x2, only recognized on the first non-empty line.

canvas_layout_overview.value: Dispose plusieurs ensembles de résultats sur une seule toile de grille. La directive canvas n'est respectée que sur la première ligne non vide ; chaque résultat : place la prochaine instruction produisant un résultat.
canvas_layout_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Canvas layout directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “-- sqlly <rows>x<columns> / -- sqlly result:” directive places several result sets on one grid-shaped canvas, with the size line honored only first and each result: line placing the next result.

canvas_layout_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Canvas layout directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “-- sqlly <rows>x<columns> / -- sqlly result:” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (arranging several results on one grid canvas).

canvas_result.value: Cellule basée sur 1 pour le prochain ensemble de résultats ; les plages couvrent des cellules.
canvas_result.location: Formatting Directives window → Canvas layout directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “result: <row>|<column>” parameter; the 1-based canvas cell where the next result set goes; ranges make it span several cells.

chart_aggregate.value: Réduire les lignes par catégorie : aucune, somme, moyenne, minimum, maximum ou compte.
chart_aggregate.location: Formatting Directives window → Chart directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “aggregate:<agg>” parameter; how rows sharing a category are combined: none, sum, average, minimum, maximum, or count.

chart_kind.value: barre, ligne, zone, nuage de points, histogramme, secteur ou anneau (obligatoire).
chart_kind.location: Formatting Directives window → Chart directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “kind:<type>” parameter; required; lists the allowed chart types as keywords (bar, line, area, scatter, histogram, pie, donut) that stay untranslated in the directive.

chart_label.value: Colonne qui étiquette les catégories (par défaut : première colonne de texte).
chart_label.location: Formatting Directives window → Chart directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “label:<col>” parameter; the column whose values label the chart's categories; defaults to the first text column.

chart_navigate.value: Cliquer sur une marque sélectionne ses lignes sources dans l'onglet Grille (par défaut vrai).
chart_navigate.location: Formatting Directives window → Chart directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “navigate:<true|false>” parameter; whether clicking a bar, point, or slice selects its source rows on the Grid tab; on by default.

chart_order.value: Ordre des catégories : source, catégorie (A–Z), ou valeur (du plus élevé au plus bas).
chart_order.location: Formatting Directives window → Chart directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “order:<order>” parameter; how categories are sorted: source order, alphabetically by category, or by value from high to low.

chart_overview.value: Configure l'onglet Graphique : type, étiquette de catégorie, série et agrégation. Associez-le avec -- sqlly view: chart pour l'ouvrir lors de l'exécution.
chart_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Chart directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “-- sqlly chart:” directive configures the result's Chart tab (type, labels, series, aggregation) and pairs with the view directive to open it on run.

chart_result.value: L'ensemble de résultats basé sur 1 auquel le graphique appartient (par défaut 1).
chart_result.location: Formatting Directives window → Chart directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “result:<n>” parameter; which 1-based result set the chart settings apply to; defaults to the first.

chart_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Chart directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “-- sqlly chart:” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (the Chart tab configuration; noun).

chart_top.value: Conserver au maximum n catégories après le classement.
chart_top.location: Formatting Directives window → Chart directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “top:<n>” parameter; limits the chart to the first n categories after sorting.

chart_values.value: Colonnes numériques à tracer en tant que séries (par défaut : détection automatique).
chart_values.location: Formatting Directives window → Chart directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “values:<col[,col…]>” parameter; the numeric column or columns plotted as series; detected automatically when omitted.

column_format_overview.value: Formate l'affichage d'une seule colonne de résultats.
column_format_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Column format directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “-- sqlly format:” directive changes how one result column is displayed.

column_format_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Column format directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “-- sqlly format:” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (per-column display formatting of a result).

computed_after.value: Placez-le après cette colonne (par défaut : à la fin).
computed_after.location: Formatting Directives window → Computed column directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “after=<column>” parameter; the existing column the new column is inserted after; appended at the end by default.

computed_column_overview.value: Ajoute une colonne calculée avec une formule Excel à partir des colonnes du résultat lui-même. Les colonnes sont écrites !Nom, la ligne avant !Nom[1], une ligne fixe !Nom[$1], et des variables déclarées @nom ; les fonctions IF, COALESCE, texte, mathématiques et date fonctionnent comme dans Excel, et une exportation Excel conserve la formule.
computed_column_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Computed column directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “-- sqlly column:” directive adds a column calculated by an Excel-style formula and explains the !Name, !Name[1], !Name[$1], and @name reference syntax, which must stay as written.

computed_column_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Computed column directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “-- sqlly column:” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (adding a formula-based column).

computed_formula.value: Une formule Excel ; le signe = initial est optionnel.
computed_formula.location: Formatting Directives window → Computed column directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “<formula>” parameter; the Excel-style formula that computes each cell; the leading equals sign may be omitted.

computed_name.value: Le nom de la nouvelle colonne.
computed_name.location: Formatting Directives window → Computed column directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “<Name>” parameter; the header name of the column being added.

computed_range.value: Une plage : cette ligne et les deux précédentes.
computed_range.location: Formatting Directives window → Computed column directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “!A[2]:!A” parameter; explains this range example covers the current row plus the two rows above it.

computed_result.value: Seulement le n-ième ensemble de résultats (par défaut : tous ceux où elle s'applique).
computed_result.location: Formatting Directives window → Computed column directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “result=<n>” parameter; restricts the computed column to the n-th result set; otherwise it is added to every result it fits.

computed_row_refs.value: Cette ligne, la ligne précédente, la première ligne.
computed_row_refs.location: Formatting Directives window → Computed column directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “!Name / !Name[1] / !Name[$1]” parameter; glosses the three reference forms in order: current row, previous row, and the fixed first row.

computed_value.value: Un -- jeu sqlly ou -- paramètre sqlly : valeur.
computed_value.location: Formatting Directives window → Computed column directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “@name” parameter; says @name refers to a value declared by a set or param directive line.

conditional_bar.value: Une barre de données proportionnelle à chaque valeur (nombres).
conditional_bar.location: Formatting Directives window → Conditional formatting directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “bar=#RRGGBB” parameter; draws an in-cell data bar whose length is proportional to each numeric value.

conditional_bold.value: Texte en gras pour les cellules correspondantes.
conditional_bold.location: Formatting Directives window → Conditional formatting directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “bold” parameter; a flag that makes the text of cells passing the test bold.

conditional_column.value: La colonne de résultat à laquelle la règle s'applique (obligatoire).
conditional_column.location: Formatting Directives window → Conditional formatting directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “column=<name>” parameter; required; the result column whose cells the coloring rule tests and styles.

conditional_fill.location: Formatting Directives window → Conditional formatting directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “fill=#RRGGBB” parameter; the background color given to cells that pass the test.

conditional_overview.value: Colorie les cellules d'une colonne selon leurs valeurs, uniquement pour cette requête. Une règle par ligne ; la première règle when= correspondante pour une colonne prévaut, et ces règles viennent avant celles enregistrées dans la boîte de dialogue de Mise en forme conditionnelle.
conditional_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Conditional formatting directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “-- sqlly conditional:” directive colors a column's cells by value for this query only, one rule per line, and takes precedence over rules saved in the Conditional Formatting dialog.

conditional_scale.value: Échelle de couleurs allant du minimum au maximum de la colonne (nombres).
conditional_scale.location: Formatting Directives window → Conditional formatting directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “scale=#RRGGBB..#RRGGBB” parameter; a two-color gradient spanning the numeric column's lowest to highest value.

conditional_text.value: Couleur de texte pour les cellules correspondantes.
conditional_text.location: Formatting Directives window → Conditional formatting directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “text=#RRGGBB” parameter; the font color given to cells that pass the test.

conditional_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Conditional formatting directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “-- sqlly conditional:” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (value-based cell coloring rules).

conditional_when.value: null, non null, > n, < n, entre a et b, est <texte>, ou contient <texte> (les tests sur le texte ignorent la casse).
conditional_when.location: Formatting Directives window → Conditional formatting directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “when=<test>” parameter; lists the available tests (null, comparisons, between, is, contains); text tests are case-insensitive.

date_phrase.value: Ce que vous avez tapé : aujourd'hui, mercredi dernier à 3h, novembre, depuis le début de l'année, 7 derniers jours…
date_phrase.location: Formatting Directives window → Natural-language date directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “<phrase>” parameter; the original plain-words date the user typed, with example phrases (today, last wed at 3, november, ytd, past 7 days) that the parser understands in English.

default_result_overview.value: Choisis quel ensemble de résultats est visible lorsque les résultats arrivent : son onglet est sélectionné dans la disposition par onglets, et sa carte est défilée dans la vue empilée. Respecté n'importe où dans le script lorsque le commentaire constitue toute la ligne ; un focus ultérieur : remplace un focus précédent.
default_result_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Default result directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “-- sqlly focus:” directive chooses which result set is in view when results arrive (selected tab or scrolled-to card) and how repeated lines resolve.

default_result_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Default result directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “-- sqlly focus:” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (which result set is shown first).

focus_result.value: L'index basé sur 1 de l'ensemble de résultats à afficher par défaut.
focus_result.location: Formatting Directives window → Default result directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “<n>” parameter; the only parameter: the 1-based number of the result set shown by default.

format_binary.location: Formatting Directives window → Column format directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “binary=<hex|base64>” parameter; chooses how binary/varbinary column values are rendered as text.

format_boolean.value: Texte à afficher pour vrai / faux, par exemple Oui/Non.
format_boolean.location: Formatting Directives window → Column format directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “boolean=<true-text>/<false-text>” parameter; the replacement words displayed for true and false values, e.g. Yes/No.

format_column.value: La colonne de résultat à laquelle cette règle s'applique (obligatoire).
format_column.location: Formatting Directives window → Column format directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “column=<name>” parameter; says which result column the format rule targets and that it is required.

format_date.location: Formatting Directives window → Column format directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “date=<pattern>” parameter; explains the value is a strftime date pattern; keep the example patterns unchanged.

format_number.value: Nombre à virgule fixe avec le nombre de décimales donné.
format_number.location: Formatting Directives window → Column format directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “number=<decimals>” parameter; shows values as fixed-point numbers with that many decimal places.

format_text.value: Changer la casse d'une colonne de texte.
format_text.location: Formatting Directives window → Column format directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “text=<upper|lower|title|none>” parameter; changes the letter case of a text column's values.

format_thousands.value: Séparateurs de milliers pour un format de nombre (par défaut vrai).
format_thousands.location: Formatting Directives window → Column format directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “thousands=<true|false>” parameter; turns digit-group separators on or off for a number format; default is on.

format_width.value: Largeur de colonne en unités relatives à la police : 1dp correspond à un quart de la taille de la police de la grille, donc une colonne conserve à peu près le même nombre de caractères visibles quelle que soit la taille de la police. Peut être le seul paramètre sur la ligne.
format_width.location: Formatting Directives window → Column format directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “width=<n>dp” parameter; explains the font-relative dp width unit (1dp = a quarter of the grid font size) and that width may be the line's only setting.

grid_columns_overview.value: Organise les colonnes d'une grille de résultats : ordre, colonnes cachées et gelées, tri, regroupement, filtres de colonnes et étiquettes de clés étrangères. Prime sur la disposition que SQLly mémorise pour la requête.
grid_columns_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Grid columns directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “-- sqlly grid:” directive sets column order, hidden and frozen columns, sorting, grouping, filters, and foreign-key labels, overriding the layout SQLly remembers for the query.

grid_columns_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Grid columns directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “-- sqlly grid:” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (arranging results-grid columns).

grid_filter.value: Un filtre de colonne (répétable) : contient, ne contient pas, commence par, se termine par, est, n'est pas, correspond à, =, !=, >, >=, <, <=, entre a et b, pas entre a et b, ou dans a | b | c.
grid_filter.location: Formatting Directives window → Grid columns directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “filter=<col> <op> <value>” parameter; a repeatable column filter, listing the allowed operators; operator words are typed in the directive.

grid_freeze.value: Épingler les n premières colonnes affichées.
grid_freeze.location: Formatting Directives window → Grid columns directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “freeze=<n>” parameter; keeps the first n visible columns pinned while scrolling horizontally.

grid_group.value: Grouper les lignes par une colonne.
grid_group.location: Formatting Directives window → Grid columns directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “group=<col>” parameter; groups the grid rows by the values of one column.

grid_hide.location: Formatting Directives window → Grid columns directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “hide=<cols>” parameter; the list of columns hidden from the grid.

grid_label.value: Étiquette de clé étrangère affichée à côté d'une colonne clé (répétable).
grid_label.location: Formatting Directives window → Grid columns directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “label=<col>:<column|off>” parameter; a repeatable foreign-key label: a readable column shown next to a key column, or off to suppress it.

grid_order.value: Ordre d'affichage ; les colonnes non listées suivent leur propre ordre.
grid_order.location: Formatting Directives window → Grid columns directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “order=<cols>” parameter; the display order of the listed columns; columns not listed keep their original order after them.

grid_result.value: Jeu de résultats facultatif basé sur 1 ; sans ceci, tous les jeux de résultats.
grid_result.location: Formatting Directives window → Grid columns directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “<n>” parameter; an optional leading 1-based result-set number; without it the line applies to every result set.

grid_sort.location: Formatting Directives window → Grid columns directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “sort=<col> [asc|desc], …” parameter; sorts by one or more columns, ascending unless desc is given.

layout_lines.value: Lignes attribuées à chaque carte empilée qui n'a pas d'allocation propre.
layout_lines.location: Formatting Directives window → Result layout directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “lines: <rows>” parameter; the default height in rows for every stacked result card without its own setting.

layout_lines_result.value: Lignes attribuées à la carte empilée du n-ième jeu de résultats (basé sur 1). Le déplacement du séparateur d'une carte le remplace toujours.
layout_lines_result.location: Formatting Directives window → Result layout directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “lines <n>: <rows>” parameter; the height in rows for one specific stacked card (the n-th result set); dragging the card divider still overrides it.

layout_mode.value: La disposition pour afficher les résultats (les onglets sont également acceptés pour les vues à onglets).
layout_mode.location: Formatting Directives window → Result layout directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “layout: stacked | tabbed | canvas” parameter; the results layout to open in; tabs is accepted as a synonym for tabbed.

name_index.value: L'index basé sur 1 du jeu de résultats à nommer.
name_index.location: Formatting Directives window → Result names directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “<n>” parameter; the 1-based position of the result set that receives the name.

name_text.value: L'étiquette à afficher sur l'onglet de ce jeu de résultats.
name_text.location: Formatting Directives window → Result names directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “<text>” parameter; the custom label that appears on that result set's tab in the Results area.

natural_date_overview.value: Écrit après une date que vous avez saisie en mots simples (Ctrl+Maj+Espace après une comparaison de date). Conserve les mots afin que la date puisse être réévaluée avec le bouton de rafraîchissement à la fin de la ligne.
natural_date_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Natural-language date directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “--sqlly date:” directive follows a date typed in plain words (inserted via Ctrl+Shift+Space) and keeps the words so the refresh button at the line end can recompute the date.

natural_date_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Natural-language date directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “--sqlly date:” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (plain-words date comments).

number_align.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot number options directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “align=<left|center|right>” parameter; the horizontal alignment of pivot number cells.

number_decimals.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot number options directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “decimals=<n>” parameter; how many digits are shown after the decimal point in pivot numbers.

number_parens.value: Mettre les nombres négatifs entre parenthèses.
number_parens.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot number options directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “parens=<true|false>” parameter; whether negative pivot numbers are shown in parentheses (accounting style).

number_red.value: Afficher les nombres négatifs en rouge.
number_red.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot number options directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “red=<true|false>” parameter; whether negative pivot numbers are drawn in red.

number_thousands.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot number options directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “thousands=<true|false>” parameter; whether pivot numbers use thousands separators; short noun phrase.

param_default.value: Valeur optionnelle utilisée lorsque le champ de la bande est laissé vide ; tapez NULL pour SQL NULL.
param_default.location: Formatting Directives window → Parameters directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “= default” parameter; an optional fallback used when the parameter strip's field is blank; NULL means SQL NULL.

param_name.value: Le symbole de remplacement à utiliser chaque fois qu'il apparaît dans le SQL (hors chaînes et commentaires).
param_name.location: Formatting Directives window → Parameters directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “@name” parameter; the placeholder name replaced throughout the SQL, except inside strings and comments.

param_type.value: L'un de texte, int, décimal, bool, date, datetime — la valeur est validée avant l'exécution.
param_type.location: Formatting Directives window → Parameters directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “<type>” parameter; the value type (text, int, decimal, bool, date, datetime — keep these keywords) checked before Run.

parameters_overview.value: Déclare un paramètre de requête. Une bande de paramètres apparaît au-dessus des résultats où vous tapez chaque valeur ; Exécuter les substitue telles que saisies, en tant que littéraux échappés.
parameters_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Parameters directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “-- sqlly param:” directive declares a query parameter whose value is typed in a strip above the results and substituted as an escaped literal on Run.

parameters_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Parameters directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “-- sqlly param:” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (query parameters typed in a strip above results); plural noun, distinct from the Parameters table section label.

pivot_columns.value: Colonne(s) dont les valeurs deviennent des colonnes pivot (obligatoire).
pivot_columns.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot table directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “column:<col[,col…]>” parameter; required; the column or columns whose distinct values become the pivot table's columns.

pivot_format.value: Format de nombre par champ (voir options ci-dessous).
pivot_format.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot table directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “format:<col>:<opts>” parameter; a number format for one pivot field, pointing to the Pivot number options card for the option list.

pivot_number_overview.value: Options partagées par le format pivot : et champs valueformat :.
pivot_number_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot number options directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “format / valueformat options” directive lists options shared by the pivot directive's format: and valueformat: fields; keep those two keywords unchanged.

pivot_number_title.value: Options de nombre pour le pivot
pivot_number_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot number options directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “format / valueformat options” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (number options for pivot format fields).

pivot_overview.value: Configure le tableau croisé dynamique lorsque la vue est pivot.
pivot_overview.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot table directive card: overview paragraph under the card heading, explaining that the “-- sqlly pivot:” directive configures the pivot table used when the result view is pivot.

pivot_result.value: L'ensemble de résultats basé sur 1 auquel le pivot appartient (par défaut 1).
pivot_result.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot table directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “result:<n>” parameter; which 1-based result set the pivot settings apply to; defaults to the first.

pivot_rows.value: Colonne(s) qui forment les lignes pivot (obligatoire).
pivot_rows.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot table directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “row:<col[,col…]>” parameter; required; the column or columns whose values form the pivot table's rows.

pivot_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot table directive card: large heading at the top of the detail pane, shown when the “-- sqlly pivot:” directive family is selected in the left list; names that family (pivot table configuration).

pivot_value.value: Colonne de valeur et agrégat : count, sum, avg, first, max ou min (obligatoire).
pivot_value.location: Formatting Directives window → Pivot table directive card → Parameters table: description beside the “value:<col>:<agg>” parameter; required; the measured column plus its aggregate (count, sum, avg, first, max, min — keep these keywords unchanged).

pivot_valueformat.value: Format numérique pour les cellules de valeur.
